for _, mt in { SignalMT, ComputedMT } do
	mt.__index = mt
	table.freeze(mt)
end

local function isNode(object: any): boolean
	local mt = getmetatable(object)
	return mt ~= nil
		and (mt == SignalMT or mt == ComputedMT or mt == Node or (type(mt) == "table" and mt.__type == Node))
end

local function isDynamic(object: any): boolean
	return type(object) == "function" or isNode(object)
end

local function raw(object: any): any
	local mt = getmetatable(object)
	if mt ~= nil then
		if mt == SignalMT then
			return object[1][VALUE]
		elseif mt == ComputedMT then
			local node = object[1]
			local st = node[STAMP]
			if st > liveMax and st ~= epoch then
				pull(node)
			end
			return node[VALUE]
		elseif mt == Node or (type(mt) == "table" and mt.__type == Node) then
			return peekData(object[1])
		end
		return object
	elseif type(object) == "function" then
		local n, s = curNode, susp
		if n == nil and s == nil then
			return (object :: () -> any)()
		end
		local pSuspRun = suspRun
		curNode, susp = nil, nil
		local ok, result = pcall(object)
		curNode, susp = n, s
		suspRun = pSuspRun
		if not ok then
			error(result, 0)
		end
		return result
	end
	return object
end

local function read(object: any): any
	local mt = getmetatable(object)
	if mt ~= nil then
		if mt == SignalMT then
			return getSignal(object[1])
		elseif mt == ComputedMT then
			return getMemo(object[1])
		elseif mt == Node or (type(mt) == "table" and mt.__type == Node) then
			return getData(object[1])
		end
		return object
	elseif type(object) == "function" then
		return (object :: () -> any)()
	end
	return object
end

local function cleanup(obj: Cleanable)
	local owner = currentOwner()
	if not owner then
		error("cannot cleanup outside a reactive owner", 2)
	elseif type(obj) ~= "function" and not isCleanable(obj) then
		error(`cannot cleanup given object: {typeof(obj)}`, 2)
	end
	anyCleanups = true
	local c = childrenOf(owner)
	local fns = c.fns
	if fns then
		table.insert(fns, obj)
	else
		c.fns = { obj }
	end
end

local function getOwner(): Owner?
	return currentOwner()
end

local function isDisposed(o: any): boolean
	local h = o[HEIGHT]
	if h == nil then
		return o[OBSERVERS] == nil
	end
	return not o[if h == INF then E_FN else FN]
end

local function finishWithOwner(
	owner: any,
	root: any,
	pOwner: any,
	pSet: boolean,
	pSusp: any,
	pCtx: any,
	pExtra: boolean,
	pSuspRun: number,
	ok: boolean,
	...: any
): ...any
	curOwner, ownerSet, susp, curCtx, ownExtra = pOwner, pSet, pSusp, pCtx, pExtra
	suspRun = pSuspRun
	if root then
		disposeOne(root)
	elseif owner and isDisposed(owner) then
		reap(owner)
	end
	if not ok then
		local err = (...)
		error(if type(err) == "string" then `error while running withOwner():\n{err}` else err, 0)
	end
	return ...
end

local function withOwner(node: any, fn: () -> ...any): ...any
	local owner: node? = if node == nil then nil elseif isNode(node) then node[1] else node
	local pOwner, pSet, pSusp, pCtx, pExtra = curOwner, ownerSet, susp, curCtx, ownExtra
	local pSuspRun = suspRun
	local root = nil
	if owner then
		curCtx = owner.ctx or pCtx
		if isDisposed(owner) then
			root = { nil, true, false, false, SCOPE, INF, true, false, false, false } :: node
			owner = root
		end
	end
	curOwner, ownerSet, susp, ownExtra = owner, true, nil, true
	return finishWithOwner(owner, root, pOwner, pSet, pSusp, pCtx, pExtra, pSuspRun, xpcall(fn, traceback))
end

local function finishUntrack(
	n: any,
	pSusp: any,
	pOwner: any,
	pSet: boolean,
	pExtra: boolean,
	pSuspRun: number,
	ok: boolean,
	...: any
): ...any
	curNode, susp, curOwner, ownerSet, ownExtra = n, pSusp, pOwner, pSet, pExtra
	suspRun = pSuspRun
	if not ok then
		local err = ...
		error(if type(err) == "string" then `error while running untrack():\n{err}` else err, 0)
	end
	return ...
end

local function untrack(fn: (() -> ...any)?): ...any
	local n = curNode
	if not fn then
		if n then
			susp, suspRun = n, curRun
			curNode = nil
			ownExtra = true
		end
		return
	end
	local pSusp, pOwner, pSet, pExtra = susp, curOwner, ownerSet, ownExtra
	local pSuspRun = suspRun
	curNode, susp = nil, nil
	if n and not ownerSet then
		curOwner, ownerSet, ownExtra = n, true, true
	end
	return finishUntrack(n, pSusp, pOwner, pSet, pExtra, pSuspRun, xpcall(fn, traceback))
end

local function retrack()
	if curNode == nil and susp and suspRun == curRun then
		curNode = susp
		susp = nil
		ownExtra = curCtx ~= nil or ownerSet
	end
end

local function dispose(obj: Cleanable?)
	local n, pSusp = curNode, susp
	local pSuspRun = suspRun
	curNode, susp = nil, nil
	clean(obj)
	curNode, susp = n, pSusp
	suspRun = pSuspRun
end

-- A context: `get` reads it and `provide` sets it for a function's extent. A frame's key is the context itself.
export type Context<T> = {
	read default: T,
	--[[
	Returns the value from the innermost active `provide` call, or `default` if none is active. Computeds, effects, and
	scopes remember the context values active when they were created.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#providing-and-reading)
	]]
	get: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Runs `fn` with this context set to `value` for all code and reactive nodes created inside `fn`, then restores the
	previous value.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#providing-and-reading)
	]]
	provide: <R>(self: any, value: T, fn: () -> R) -> R,
}

--- @ignore
type ContextData<T> = { default: T }

local context: <T>(default: T) -> Context<T>
do
	local Context = {}
	Context.__index = Context
	--[[
	Returns the value from the innermost active `provide` call, or `default` if none is active. Computeds, effects, and
	scopes remember the context values active when they were created.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#providing-and-reading)
	]]
	function Context.get<T>(self: ContextData<T>): T
		local frame = curCtx
		while frame do
			if frame.key == self then
				return frame.value
			end
			frame = frame.parent
		end
		return self.default
	end

	--[[
	Runs `fn` with this context set to `value` for all code and reactive nodes created inside `fn`, then restores the
	previous value.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#providing-and-reading)
	]]
	function Context.provide<T, R>(self: ContextData<T>, value: T, fn: () -> R): R
		if type(fn) ~= "function" then
			error("Context:provide() expects a function as its second argument", 2)
		end
		local prevContext, prevExtra = curCtx, ownExtra
		ownExtra = true
		curCtx = { parent = prevContext, key = self, value = value }
		local ok, result = xpcall(fn, traceback)
		curCtx, ownExtra = prevContext, prevExtra
		if not ok then
			error(result, 0)
		end
		return result
	end

	function context(default: any): any
		return setmetatable({ default = default }, Context)
	end
end

local function finishBindContext(prevContext: any, prevExtra: boolean, ok: boolean, ...: any): ...any
	curCtx, ownExtra = prevContext, prevExtra
	if not ok then
		error((...), 0)
	end
	return ...
end

local function bindContext<A..., R...>(fn: (A...) -> R...): (A...) -> R...
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		error("bindContext expects a function", 2)
	end
	local ctx = curCtx
	if ctx == nil then
		return fn
	end
	return function(...: A...): R...
		local prevContext, prevExtra = curCtx, ownExtra
		curCtx, ownExtra = ctx, true
		return finishBindContext(prevContext, prevExtra, xpcall(fn :: (...any) -> ...any, traceback, ...))
	end
end

local function attach(o: any, node: any)
	if o then
		local slot = if o[HEIGHT] == INF then E_CHILDREN else CHILDREN
		local c = o[slot]
		if c then
			local n = c[1] + 1
			c[1] = n
			c[n] = node
		else
			o[slot] = { 2, node }
		end
	end
end

local function enqueue(node: any)
	local qt = queueTail + 1
	queueTail = qt
	queue[qt] = node
end

local function scope<T>(fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> T): (Node<any>, T)
	local inner = { nil, true, false, false, SCOPE, INF, true, false, false, false }
	if ownExtra then
		ownSlow(inner)
	else
		attach(curNode or curOwner, inner)
	end
	local node: any = setmetatable({ inner }, Node)
	local pNode, pOwner, pSet, pSusp, pIdx, pNew = curNode, curOwner, ownerSet, susp, curIdx, curNew
	local pSuspRun = suspRun
	curNode, curOwner, ownerSet, susp = nil, inner, false, nil
	local ok, result = xpcall(fn, traceback, node)
	curNode, curOwner, ownerSet, susp, curIdx, curNew = pNode, pOwner, pSet, pSusp, pIdx, pNew
	suspRun = pSuspRun
	if inner[FN] == false then
		reap(inner)
	end
	if not ok then
		disposeOne(inner)
		error(if type(result) == "string" then `error while running scope():\n{result}` else result, 0)
	end
	return node, result
end

local function signal(initial: any, equals: any): any
	local node = { initial, 0, 0, 0, nil, nil }
	if equals then
		node.equals = equals
		anySigEquals = true
	end
	return setmetatable({ node }, SignalMT)
end

local function wrapComputedEquals(node: any, fn: any, equals: any)
	node.equals = equals
	node[FN] = function(prev: any)
		local v = fn(prev)
		if v ~= prev and node[CHANGED] ~= 0 and equals(prev, v) then
			node[VALUE] = v
			return prev
		end
		return v
	end
end

local function computed(fn: any, equals: any): any
	local node = { nil, false, 0, 0, 1, 0, fn, SRC1, false, false, nil, nil }
	if equals then
		wrapComputedEquals(node, fn, equals)
	end
	if ownExtra then
		ownSlow(node)
	else
		attach(curNode or curOwner, node)
	end
	return setmetatable({ node }, ComputedMT)
end

local function createEffect(fn: (...any) -> ...any)
	local node: any = { nil, E_SRC1, fn, false, INF, 0, nil, nil }
	if ownExtra then
		ownSlow(node)
	else
		attach(curNode or curOwner, node)
	end
	enqueue(node)
end

local function effect(fn: (...any) -> ...any): any
	local node: any = { nil, E_SRC1, fn, false, INF, 0, nil, nil }
	if ownExtra then
		ownSlow(node)
	else
		attach(curNode or curOwner, node)
	end
	enqueue(node)
	return setmetatable({ node }, Node)
end

local function getter(node: any): any
	local mt = getmetatable(node)
	if mt == SignalMT then
		local inner = node[1]
		return function(): any
			return getSignal(inner)
		end
	elseif mt == ComputedMT then
		local inner = node[1]
		return function(): any
			return getMemo(inner)
		end
	elseif mt == Node or (mt ~= nil and type(mt) == "table" and mt.__type == Node) then
		local inner = node[1]
		return function(): any
			return getData(inner)
		end
	end
	error(`Flux.getter expects a node, got {typeof(node)}`, 2)
end

local function setter(node: any): any
	local mt = getmetatable(node)
	if mt == SignalMT then
		local inner = node[1]
		return function(value: any, force: boolean?): any
			return setSignal(inner, value, force)
		end
	elseif mt == ComputedMT or mt == Node or (mt ~= nil and type(mt) == "table" and mt.__type == Node) then
		local inner = node[1]
		return function(value: any, force: boolean?): any
			return setData(inner, value, force)
		end
	end
	error(`Flux.setter expects a node, got {typeof(node)}`, 2)
end

local function createSignal<T>(initial: T, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?): (() -> T, (value: T, force: boolean?) -> T)
	local node = { initial, 0, 0, 0, nil, nil }
	if equals then
		node.equals = equals
		anySigEquals = true
	end
	return function(): any
		return getSignal(node)
	end, function(value: any, force: boolean?): any
		return setSignal(node, value, force)
	end
end

local function createMemo<T>(fn: () -> T, equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?): () -> T
	local node = { nil, false, 0, 0, 1, 0, fn, SRC1, false, false, nil, nil }
	if equals then
		wrapComputedEquals(node, fn, equals)
	end
	if ownExtra then
		ownSlow(node)
	else
		attach(curNode or curOwner, node)
	end
	return function(): any
		return getMemo(node)
	end
end

local function new(obj: any, isEffect: boolean?, equals: any): any
	if isNode(obj) then
		return obj
	end
	if type(obj) == "function" then
		if isEffect then
			return effect(obj)
		end
		return computed(obj, equals)
	end
	return signal(obj, equals)
end

local safe: <T>(tryFn: () -> T, fallback: T | (err: unknown) -> T, equals: ((a: T, b: T) -> boolean)?) -> Node<T>
do
	local function recoverSafe<T>(handler: (err: unknown) -> T, err: unknown): T
		local n, s, sr = curNode, susp, suspRun
		curNode, susp = nil, nil
		local ok, result = pcall(handler, err)
		curNode, susp, suspRun = n, s, sr
		if not ok then
			error(result, 0)
		end
		return result
	end

	function safe<T>(tryFn: () -> T, fallback: T | (err: unknown) -> T, equals: ((a: T, b: T) -> boolean)?): Node<T>
		return computed(function()
			local ok, result = pcall(tryFn)
			if ok then
				return result
			end
			if type(fallback) == "function" then
				return recoverSafe(fallback :: (unknown) -> T, result)
			end
			return fallback
		end, equals)
	end
end

local function isStale(node: any): boolean
	return node[1][STAMP] == 0 or heapMin ~= INF
end

-- Methods every node has that sit behind `__index` in the types, so the solver only expands them on use.
--- @ignore
type Hooks = {
	--[[
	Runs `fn` when an effect starts depending on the node, either directly or through computeds. Pair it with
	`node:onUnobserved` to start and stop external work only while anything is listening.
	]]
	read onObserved: (self: any, fn: () -> ()) -> (),
	--[[
	Runs `fn` when no effect depends on the node anymore, either directly or through computeds.
	]]
	read onUnobserved: (self: any, fn: () -> ()) -> (),
}

-- A node's operators. Every member is `read` and `T` appears only in results, so nodes are covariant in `T`. A typed
-- write parameter on `__call` makes the solver stop checking the rest of a node, so calls are never write-checked.
--- @ignore
type Operators<T> = {
	read __call: (self: any, value: any, force: boolean?) -> T,
	read __concat: (a: any, b: any) -> string,
	read __tostring: (self: any) -> string,
	read __unm: (self: any) -> number,
	read __add: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __sub: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __mul: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __div: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __idiv: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __mod: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __pow: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __lt: (a: any, b: any) -> boolean,
	read __le: (a: any, b: any) -> boolean,
	read __index: Hooks,
}

--[[
A reactive node holding a `T` (a signal, computed, effect, or scope). Covariant in `T` so `Node<"a">` is assignable to
`Node<string>`.
]]
export type Node<T = any> = setmetatable<{
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value without subscribing the caller.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read peek: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value (`node()` does the same) and subscribes the running
	[computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read get: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Writes `value` (`node(value)` does the same), skipping propagation when it equals the current value (`~=` or the
	node's `equals`). Pass `force = true` to notify dependents anyway.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#updating-a-signal)
	]]
	read set: (self: any, value: any, force: boolean?) -> T,
	--[[
	Notifies the node's dependents without changing its value, useful after mutating a table in place.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#forcing-an-update)
	]]
	read update: <N>(self: N) -> N,
	--[[
	Disconnects the node from its sources and observers, then runs its pending [`Flux.cleanup`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#cleanup-with-flux-cleanup)
	values and `onDestroy` callbacks. Later reads return `nil`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read Destroy: (self: any) -> (),
	--[[
	Registers `fn` to run with the node's last value when the node is destroyed. Unlike `Flux.cleanup`, `onDestroy`
	callbacks only run on final teardown and survive re-runs.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read onDestroy: (self: any, fn: (oldValue: T) -> ()) -> (),
}, Operators<T>>

--[[
A writable signal node whose `:set(value)` method is type-checked against `T`. Assignable wherever `Node<T>` or
`Reactive<T>` is expected.
]]
export type State<T = any> = setmetatable<{
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value without subscribing the caller.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read peek: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value (`node()` does the same) and subscribes the running
	[computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read get: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Writes `value` (`node(value)` does the same), skipping propagation when it equals the current value (`~=` or the
	node's `equals`). Pass `force = true` to notify dependents anyway.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#updating-a-signal)
	]]
	read set: (self: any, value: T, force: boolean?) -> T,
	--[[
	Notifies the node's dependents without changing its value, useful after mutating a table in place.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#forcing-an-update)
	]]
	read update: <N>(self: N) -> N,
	--[[
	Disconnects the node from its sources and observers, then runs its pending [`Flux.cleanup`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#cleanup-with-flux-cleanup)
	values and `onDestroy` callbacks. Later reads return `nil`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read Destroy: (self: any) -> (),
	--[[
	Registers `fn` to run with the node's last value when the node is destroyed. Unlike `Flux.cleanup`, `onDestroy`
	callbacks only run on final teardown and survive re-runs.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read onDestroy: (self: any, fn: (oldValue: T) -> ()) -> (),
}, Operators<T>>

--[[
A plain `T`, a `Node<T>`, or a `() -> T` getter function. Read it with `Flux.read` or `Flux.raw`.

```luau
type Props = { label: Flux.Reactive<string>, disabled: Flux.Reactive<boolean>? }
local function Label(props: Props) end

local function label<A>(value: A): Flux.Node<Flux.Unwrap<A>>
	return Flux.computed(function()
		return Flux.read(value)
	end)
end
```
]]
export type Reactive<T> = T | Node<T> | (() -> T)

--[[
Extracts the underlying value type `T` from a `Node<T>`, getter `() -> T`, or plain `T` (distributing over unions).
]]
export type function Unwrap(value: type): type
	local function returned(fn: type): type
		local head = fn:returns().head
		return if head and head[1] then head[1] else types.singleton(nil)
	end

	local function nodeValue(t: type): type?
		if not t:is("table") then
			return nil
		end
		local get = t:readproperty(types.singleton("get"))
		if get and get:is("function") and t:readproperty(types.singleton("peek")) then
			return returned(get)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function unwrap(t: type): type
		if t:is("union") then
			local parts: { type } = {}
			local function add(part: type)
				if part:is("union") then
					for _, member in part:components() do
						add(member)
					end
				elseif not table.find(parts, part) then
					table.insert(parts, part)
				end
			end
			for _, part in t:components() do
				add(unwrap(part))
			end
			return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
		elseif t:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in t:components() do
				local found = nodeValue(part)
				if found then
					return found
				end
			end
			return t
		elseif t:is("function") then
			return returned(t)
		end
		return nodeValue(t) or t
	end

	return unwrap(value)
end

-- An owner handle from `getOwner`, for `withOwner`.
export type Owner = { any }

local Graph = {
	--[[
	Wraps `obj` in a reactive node: a [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) for a plain value, a
	[computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) for a function, or an
	[effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) when `isEffect` is `true` (existing nodes pass through as-is).
	]]
	new = new :: <T>(obj: T, isEffect: boolean?, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?) -> Node<T>,
	--[[
	Creates a writable [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) holding `initial`, using `equals` (default
	`==`) to skip unchanged writes. Signals aren't owned by enclosing scopes and are garbage-collected once unreferenced.

	```luau
	local count = Flux.signal(0)
	count(count() + 1)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals)
	]]
	signal = signal :: <T>(initial: T, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?) -> State<T>,
	--[[
	Creates a lazily cached [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) node derived from `fn`. Re-evaluates
	only when read after a dependency changes, and uses `equals` (default `==`) to stop propagation when the result is unchanged.

	```luau
	local total = Flux.computed(function()
		return price() * quantity()
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds)
	]]
	computed = computed :: <T>(fn: () -> T, equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?) -> Node<T>,
	--[[
	Schedules `fn` to run on the next flush and re-run whenever any node it reads changes. Owned by the enclosing scope or
	stopped manually with `node:Destroy()`.

	```luau
	Flux.effect(function() print("count is", count()) end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects)
	]]
	effect = effect :: (fn: (...any) -> ...any) -> Node<any>,
	--[[
	Returns a plain function that reads `node` with tracking, avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.

	```luau
	local count = Flux.signal(0)
	local getCount = Flux.getter(count)
	Flux.effect(function()
		print(getCount())
	end)
	```
	]]
	getter = getter :: <A>(node: A) -> () -> Unwrap<A>,
	--[[
	Returns a plain function that writes `node` (`setter(value, force)`), avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.
	]]
	setter = setter :: <T>(node: State<T>) -> (value: T, force: boolean?) -> T,
	--[[
	Creates a lightweight signal without a node wrapper and returns `(getter, setter)`. Faster and smaller than
	`Flux.signal`, with no methods (`Destroy`, `onObserved`, etc.).

	```luau
	local count, setCount = Flux.createSignal(0)
	Flux.effect(function()
		print(count())
	end)
	setCount(count() + 1)
	```
	]]
	createSignal = createSignal,
	--[[
	Creates a lightweight computed without a node wrapper and returns its tracked getter function. Owned by the active
	scope or reaction like `Flux.computed`.

	```luau
	local count, setCount = Flux.createSignal(1)
	local doubled = Flux.createMemo(function()
		return count() * 2
	end)
	```
	]]
	createMemo = createMemo,
	--[[
	Creates a lightweight effect without returning a node wrapper. Owned by the active scope or reaction like `Flux.effect`.

	```luau
	local count, setCount = Flux.createSignal(0)
	Flux.createEffect(function()
		print("count is", count())
	end)
	```
	]]
	createEffect = createEffect,
	--[[
	Runs all queued [effects](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) immediately instead of waiting for the next frame.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/tips/testing#deterministic-effects-with-flux-flush)
	]]
	flush = flush,
	-- Overloaded so a body that returns nothing type-checks: a generic `T` can't stand for an empty return.
	--[[
	Runs `fn` in a new owner [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) and returns `(scope, result)`. Calling
	`scope:Destroy()` tears down every computed, effect, instance, and `cleanup` created inside `fn`.

	```luau
	local scope, frame = Flux.scope(function() return Flux.new "Frame" { Parent = gui } end)
	scope:Destroy() -- destroys the frame and everything bound to it
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#creating-a-scope)
	]]
	scope = scope :: ((fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> ()) -> Node<any>) & (<T>(fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> T) -> (Node<any>, T)),
	--[[
	Registers `obj` to be disposed via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#disposing-by-hand-with-flux-dispose)
	before the running reaction re-runs and when its owner is destroyed. Cleanup functions receive `(previousValue, isDestroyed)`.

	```luau
	Flux.effect(function()
		local connection = button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
		Flux.cleanup(connection)
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#cleanup-with-flux-cleanup)
	]]
	cleanup = cleanup,
	--[[
	Tears down `obj` immediately (functions, instances, connections, threads, objects with `Destroy`/`Disconnect` methods,
	or arrays of cleanables). Runs untracked and warns on error instead of throwing.

	```luau
	local connections = { part.Touched:Connect(onTouched), part.Destroying:Connect(onGone) }
	Flux.dispose(connections)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#disposing-by-hand-with-flux-dispose)
	]]
	dispose = dispose,
	--[[
	Returns the active reactive owner, or `nil` at the root. Pass it to [`Flux.withOwner`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#capturing-the-active-scope)
	to attach deferred work to the same scope.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#capturing-the-active-scope)
	]]
	getOwner = getOwner,
	--[[
	Runs `fn` with `owner` (from `Flux.getOwner`, a node, or `nil` for unowned roots) as the active owner and restores its
	captured [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code). If `owner` is already destroyed, anything
	created inside `fn` is disposed as soon as `fn` finishes.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#capturing-the-active-scope)
	]]
	withOwner = withOwner :: <T...>(node: Node<any> | Owner | nil, fn: () -> T...) -> T...,
	--[[
	Runs `fn` without dependency [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) and returns its result. Called with
	no arguments (`Flux.untrack()`), it suspends tracking for the rest of the current reaction body or until `Flux.retrack()`.

	```luau
	Flux.effect(function()
		local id = selected() -- tracked
		local name = Flux.untrack(function() return names()[id] end) -- not tracked
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#flux-untrack)
	]]
	untrack = untrack :: <T>(fn: (() -> ...T)?) -> ...T,
	--[[
	Resumes [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) after a bare `Flux.untrack()` in the same function body.

	```luau
	Flux.untrack()
	local snapshot = rows()
	Flux.retrack()
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#imperative-pairing-flux-untrack-flux-retrack)
	]]
	retrack = retrack,
	--[[
	Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) without subscribing the running reaction.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#flux-raw)
	]]
	raw = raw :: <T>(object: T) -> Unwrap<T>,
	--[[
	Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) and subscribes the running reaction if it's dynamic.

	```luau
	local function Label(props: { text: Flux.Reactive<string> })
		return Flux.new "TextLabel" { Text = function() return string.upper(Flux.read(props.text)) end }
	end
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#flux-read)
	]]
	read = read :: <T>(object: T) -> Unwrap<T>,
	--[[
	Creates a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) that evaluates `tryFn` and returns `fallback` (a
	static value or an untracked `(err) -> T` function) if `tryFn` throws. Automatically recovers when tracked dependencies
	change.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/tips/errors#structured-error-handling-flux-safe)
	]]
	safe = safe,
	--[[
	Creates a [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context) with the given `default` value for passing data down a
	component tree without prop drilling.

	```luau
	local Theme = Flux.context("dark")
	Theme:provide("light", function() return App {} end) -- App and everything it builds reads "light"
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#creating-a-context)
	]]
	context = context :: <T>(default: T) -> Context<T>,
	--[[
	Wraps `fn` so every call sees the [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code) values active
	when `bindContext` was called. Event handlers in `Flux.new`/`Flux.edit` do this automatically.

	```luau
	local onClick = Flux.bindContext(function()
		print(ThemeContext:get()) -- the value provided where onClick was made
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code)
	]]
	bindContext = bindContext,
	--[[
	Returns `true` if `object` is a Flux [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/components#_2-reading-node-or-value-props-with-flux-read)
	]]
	isNode = isNode,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether `value` is a node or a getter, a value a binding must track.
	--- @ignore
	isDynamic = isDynamic,
	--[[
	Returns `true` if called inside a tracking [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or
	[effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).
	]]
	isReactive = isReactive,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether an effect node may be stale before the next flush (Selector's watcher).
	--- @ignore
	isStale = isStale,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether any reaction observes a node (Selector's sweep).
	--- @ignore
	isObserved = isObserved,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether `dispose` would tear `obj` down.
	--- @ignore
	isCleanable = isCleanable,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): registers `teardown` as how `dispose` tears `obj` down.
	--- @ignore
	register = register,
	--- @ignore
	kindOf = kindOf,
	Node = table.freeze(Node),
}

return table.freeze(Graph)

--!strict
--[[
Interaction state as read-only boolean nodes (`hover`, `press`, `selected`, `focused`) and the hit tests `pointIn`,
`sunk` and `covered`. Available as `Flux.Interact`.

```luau
local hovered = Flux.Interact.hover(button)
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local Enum = Compat.Enum

local dispose = Graph.dispose
local signal = Graph.signal

-- The engine services `press` and `selected` listen to; the specs hand in stand-ins.
--- @ignore
export type Services = {
	GuiService: GuiService,
	UserInputService: UserInputService,
}

export type HoverOptions = {
	-- Only guis outside the object cover it: a row, a card or a scrolling area stays hovered over its own buttons.
	within: boolean?,
}

-- What hover listens to. `events` hands out an object's own pointer events: the object itself, or a spec's stand-ins.
--- @ignore
export type HoverServices = {
	GuiService: any,
	UserInputService: any,
	RunService: any,
	events: ((object: any) -> any)?,
}

local MOUSE_MOVEMENT = Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
local MOUSE_BUTTON1 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
local TOUCH = Enum.UserInputType.Touch
local ACTIVATE_KEYS: { [any]: boolean } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA] = true,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Return] = true,
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter] = true,
}

local engine: HoverServices? = nil

local function engineServices(): any
	local resolved = engine
	if resolved == nil then
		local guiService = Compat.getService("GuiService")
		if guiService == nil then
			return nil
		end
		resolved = {
			GuiService = guiService,
			UserInputService = Compat.getService("UserInputService"),
			RunService = Compat.getService("RunService"),
		} :: HoverServices
		engine = resolved
	end
	return resolved
end

local function menuOpen(env: { GuiService: any }?): boolean
	return env ~= nil and env.GuiService.MenuIsOpen == true
end

--[[
Whether the point `(x, y)` lies within `object`'s absolute bounds (inclusive, ignoring rotation).
Coordinates are inset-relative, matching `InputObject.Position` and `AbsolutePosition`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#pointin)
]]
local function pointIn(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject): boolean
	local position, size = object.AbsolutePosition, object.AbsoluteSize
	return x >= position.X and x <= position.X + size.X and y >= position.Y and y <= position.Y + size.Y
end

local memoToken: any = nil
local memoRoot: Instance? = nil
local memoX, memoY = 0, 0
local memoList: { GuiObject } = {}

local function guisAt(root: BasePlayerGui, x: number, y: number): { GuiObject }?
	local ok, list = pcall(root.GetGuiObjectsAtPosition, root, x, y)
	return if ok then list else nil
end

local function hits(root: BasePlayerGui, x: number, y: number, token: any?): { GuiObject }?
	if token ~= nil and token == memoToken and root == memoRoot and x == memoX and y == memoY then
		return memoList
	end
	local list = guisAt(root, x, y)
	if list ~= nil and token ~= nil then
		memoToken, memoRoot, memoX, memoY, memoList = token, root, x, y, list
	end
	return list
end

local function claims(gui: GuiObject, object: GuiObject, within: boolean): boolean
	return (gui.Active or gui.InputSink.Value ~= 0) and not (within and gui:IsDescendantOf(object))
end

local function scan(list: { GuiObject }, object: GuiObject, within: boolean): (boolean, boolean)
	local claimed = false
	for _, gui in list do
		if gui == object then
			return true, claimed
		elseif not claimed and claims(gui, object, within) then
			claimed = true
		end
	end
	return false, claimed
end

local function claimedAt(
	env: { GuiService: any }?,
	x: number,
	y: number,
	object: GuiObject,
	token: any?,
	within: boolean
): boolean
	local root = object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePlayerGui")
	if root == nil then
		return false
	elseif menuOpen(env) then
		return true
	end
	local list = hits(root, x, y, token)
	if list == nil then
		return false
	end
	local _, claimed = scan(list, object, within)
	return claimed
end

--[[
Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI rendered above `object` (or while the Roblox escape menu is open).
Pass the `InputObject` as `token` to share the hit-test query across multiple controls on the same input event.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#sunk)
]]
local function sunk(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean
	return claimedAt(engineServices(), x, y, object, token, false)
end

--[[
Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI above `object` that is not a descendant of `object`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#covered)
]]
local function covered(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean
	return claimedAt(engineServices(), x, y, object, token, true)
end

--- @ignore
type Listener = {
	count: number,
	connections: { RBXScriptConnection }?,
	open: () -> { RBXScriptConnection },
	last: any?,
}

local function retain(listener: Listener)
	listener.count += 1
	if listener.count == 1 and listener.connections == nil then
		listener.connections = listener.open()
	end
end

local function release(listener: Listener)
	listener.count -= 1
	local connections = listener.connections
	if listener.count == 0 and connections ~= nil then
		listener.connections = nil
		listener.last = nil
		memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
		dispose(connections)
	end
end

--- @ignore
type Handler = (any) -> ()
--- @ignore
type Hub = Listener & {
	handlers: { [Instance]: { [Handler]: true } },
	last: Instance?,
}

--- @ignore
type Entry = {
	object: GuiObject,
	state: Graph.Node<boolean>,
	within: boolean,
	root: Instance?,
	touch: InputObject?,
}

--- @ignore
type Tracker = Listener & {
	env: HoverServices,
	inside: { [Entry]: true },
	touched: { [Entry]: true },
	x: number?,
	y: number?,
}

--- @ignore
type Registry = { activate: Hub, selected: Hub, hover: Tracker }

local registries: { [any]: Registry } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function dispatch(hub: Hub, object: Instance?, value: any)
	local set = if object ~= nil then hub.handlers[object] else nil
	if set == nil then
		return
	end
	for handler in set do
		handler(value)
	end
end

local function hubAdd(hub: Hub, object: Instance, handler: Handler)
	local set = hub.handlers[object]
	if set == nil then
		set = {}
		hub.handlers[object] = set
	end
	if not set[handler] then
		set[handler] = true
		retain(hub)
	end
end

local function hubRemove(hub: Hub, object: Instance, handler: Handler)
	local set = hub.handlers[object]
	if set == nil or not set[handler] then
		return
	end
	set[handler] = nil
	if next(set) == nil then
		hub.handlers[object] = nil
	end
	release(hub)
end

local function leavesMouse(kind: any): boolean
	return kind == TOUCH or string.sub(kind.Name, 1, 7) == "Gamepad"
end

local function settleTouch(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry)
	if entry.touch ~= nil then
		entry.touch = nil
		tracker.touched[entry] = nil
		release(tracker)
	end
	if entry.root == nil then
		entry.state:set(false)
	end
	memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
end

local function leave(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry)
	if entry.root ~= nil then
		if entry.root == memoRoot then
			memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
		end
		entry.root = nil
		tracker.inside[entry] = nil
		release(tracker)
	end
	if entry.touch == nil then
		entry.state:set(false)
	end
end

local function stepTracker(tracker: Tracker)
	if menuOpen(tracker.env) then
		for entry in tracker.inside do
			entry.state:set(false)
		end
		for entry in tracker.touched do
			settleTouch(tracker, entry)
		end
		return
	end
	local x, y = tracker.x, tracker.y
	if x == nil or y == nil then
		return
	end
	local lastRoot: any, lastList: { GuiObject } = nil, {}
	for entry in tracker.inside do
		local root: any = entry.root
		if root ~= lastRoot then
			local list = guisAt(root, x, y)
			if list == nil then
				continue
			end
			lastRoot, lastList = root, list
		end
		local found, claimed = scan(lastList, entry.object, entry.within)
		if not found then
			leave(tracker, entry)
		elseif entry.touch == nil then
			entry.state:set(not claimed)
		end
	end
end

local function connectTracker(tracker: Tracker): { RBXScriptConnection }
	local env = tracker.env
	tracker.x, tracker.y = nil, nil
	local input = env.UserInputService
	local function clearMouse()
		for entry in tracker.inside do
			leave(tracker, entry)
		end
		memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
	end
	local onHeartbeat = env.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		stepTracker(tracker)
	end)
	local onChanged = input.InputChanged:Connect(function(changed: InputObject)
		if changed.UserInputType == MOUSE_MOVEMENT then
			tracker.x, tracker.y = changed.Position.X, changed.Position.Y
		end
	end)
	local onEnded = input.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended: InputObject)
		if ended.UserInputType == TOUCH then
			for entry in tracker.touched do
				if entry.touch == ended then
					settleTouch(tracker, entry)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	local onLastInput = input.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(kind: any)
		if leavesMouse(kind) then
			clearMouse()
		end
	end)
	local onFocusReleased = input.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(clearMouse)
	return { onHeartbeat, onChanged, onEnded, onLastInput, onFocusReleased }
end

local function registryFor(env: any): Registry
	local registry = registries[env]
	if registry ~= nil then
		return registry
	end

	local activate: any = { handlers = {}, count = 0 }
	activate.open = function(): { RBXScriptConnection }
		local userInput = env.UserInputService
		local onInputBegan = userInput.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if ACTIVATE_KEYS[input.KeyCode] and userInput:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil and not menuOpen(env) then
				dispatch(activate, env.GuiService.SelectedObject, input)
			end
		end)
		return { onInputBegan }
	end

	local selected: any = { handlers = {}, count = 0 }
	selected.open = function(): { RBXScriptConnection }
		local guiService = env.GuiService
		selected.last = guiService.SelectedObject
		local onSelectedChanged = guiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SelectedObject"):Connect(function()
			local now = guiService.SelectedObject
			local last = selected.last
			if now ~= last then
				selected.last = now
				dispatch(selected, last, false)
				dispatch(selected, now, true)
			end
		end)
		return { onSelectedChanged }
	end

	local tracker: any = { env = env, inside = {}, touched = {}, count = 0 }
	tracker.open = function(): { RBXScriptConnection }
		local connected = connectTracker(tracker)
		return connected
	end

	registry = { activate = activate, selected = selected, hover = tracker }
	registries[env] = registry
	return registry
end

local function expose(state: Graph.Node<boolean>, object: Instance, onRelease: () -> ()): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local settled = false
	local destroying: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local function settle()
		if settled then
			return
		end
		settled = true
		if destroying ~= nil then
			destroying:Disconnect()
			destroying = nil
		end
		onRelease()
	end
	destroying = object.Destroying:Connect(settle)
	state:onDestroy(settle)
	if Graph.getOwner() then
		Graph.cleanup(settle)
	end
	return state
end

local function enter(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry, x: number?, y: number?)
	if entry.root == nil then
		local root = entry.object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePlayerGui")
		if root == nil then
			return
		end
		entry.root = root
		tracker.inside[entry] = true
		retain(tracker)
	end
	if x ~= nil then
		tracker.x, tracker.y = x, y
	elseif tracker.x == nil then
		local env = tracker.env
		local ok, at = pcall(function(): Vector2
			return env.UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - env.GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		end)
		if ok then
			tracker.x, tracker.y = at.X, at.Y
		end
	end
end

local function _hoverWith(object: GuiObject, env: HoverServices?, options: HoverOptions?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local within = options ~= nil and options.within == true
	local hovering = signal(false)
	local events: any = if env ~= nil and env.events ~= nil then env.events(object) else object
	local entry: Entry = { object = object, state = hovering, within = within }
	local tracker = if env ~= nil then registryFor(env).hover else nil

	local function track(input: InputObject)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind ~= MOUSE_MOVEMENT and kind ~= TOUCH then
			return
		end
		if kind == TOUCH and entry.touch ~= nil and entry.touch ~= input then
			return
		end
		local pos = input.Position
		local on = not menuOpen(env) and not claimedAt(env, pos.X, pos.Y, object, input, within)
		hovering:set(on)
		if kind == MOUSE_MOVEMENT then
			if tracker ~= nil then
				enter(tracker, entry, pos.X, pos.Y)
			end
		elseif tracker ~= nil then
			if on and entry.touch == nil then
				entry.touch = input
				tracker.touched[entry] = true
				retain(tracker)
			elseif not on and entry.touch ~= nil then
				settleTouch(tracker, entry)
			end
		end
	end

	local onBegan: RBXScriptConnection = events.InputBegan:Connect(track)
	local onChanged: RBXScriptConnection = events.InputChanged:Connect(track)
	local onEnded: RBXScriptConnection = events.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind == MOUSE_MOVEMENT then
			if tracker ~= nil then
				leave(tracker, entry)
			else
				hovering:set(false)
			end
		elseif kind == TOUCH then
			if entry.touch ~= nil and entry.touch ~= input then
				return
			end
			if tracker ~= nil and entry.touch ~= nil then
				settleTouch(tracker, entry)
			end
			hovering:set(false)
		end
	end)
	local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = { onBegan, onChanged, onEnded }
	local mouseEnter: any = events.MouseEnter
	local mouseLeave: any = events.MouseLeave
	if tracker ~= nil and mouseEnter ~= nil then
		local tracking: Tracker = tracker
		local onEnter: RBXScriptConnection = mouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not leavesMouse(tracking.env.UserInputService:GetLastInputType()) then
				enter(tracking, entry)
			end
		end)
		local onLeave: RBXScriptConnection = mouseLeave:Connect(function()
			leave(tracking, entry)
		end)
		table.insert(connections, onEnter)
		table.insert(connections, onLeave)
	end

	return expose(hovering, object, function()
		dispose(connections)
		table.clear(connections)
		if tracker ~= nil then
			if entry.touch ~= nil then
				settleTouch(tracker, entry)
			end
			leave(tracker, entry)
		end
		hovering:set(false)
	end)
end

local hoverOverride: HoverServices? = nil

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while a pointer or touch contact is inside `object` with no input-claiming GUI above it.
Pass `{ within = true }` on containers so child controls inside `object` do not count as covering it.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#hover)
]]
local function hover(object: GuiObject, options: HoverOptions?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	return _hoverWith(object, hoverOverride or engineServices(), options)
end

local function useHoverServices(env: HoverServices?): HoverServices?
	local previous = hoverOverride
	hoverOverride = env
	return previous
end

local function _pressWith(object: GuiObject, env: Services?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local pressed = signal(false)
	local held: InputObject? = nil
	local releaseListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local menuListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

	local function releasePress()
		held = nil
		if menuListener ~= nil then
			menuListener:Disconnect()
			menuListener = nil
		end
		local listener = releaseListener
		if listener ~= nil then
			releaseListener = nil
			listener:Disconnect()
		end
		pressed:set(false)
	end

	local function isHeld(input: InputObject): boolean
		local current = held
		if current == nil then
			return false
		elseif input == current then
			return true
		end
		local kind = current.UserInputType
		return kind ~= TOUCH and input.UserInputType == kind and input.KeyCode == current.KeyCode
	end

	local function hold(input: InputObject)
		if held ~= nil or menuOpen(env) then
			return
		end
		held = input
		pressed:set(true)
		if env ~= nil then
			menuListener = env.GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MenuIsOpen"):Connect(function()
				if menuOpen(env) then
					releasePress()
				end
			end)
			releaseListener = env.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended: InputObject)
				if isHeld(ended) then
					releasePress()
				end
			end)
		else
			releaseListener = object.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended: InputObject)
				if isHeld(ended) then
					releasePress()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local pointer = object.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind == MOUSE_BUTTON1 or kind == TOUCH then
			local position = input.Position
			if not claimedAt(env, position.X, position.Y, object, input, false) then
				hold(input)
			end
		end
	end)
	local hub = if env ~= nil then registryFor(env).activate else nil
	local holdHandler: any = hold
	if hub ~= nil then
		hubAdd(hub, object, holdHandler)
	end

	return expose(pressed, object, function()
		pointer:Disconnect()
		if hub ~= nil then
			hubRemove(hub, object, holdHandler)
		end
		releasePress()
	end)
end

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while `object` is held down by pointer, touch, or gamepad/keyboard activation (`ButtonA`/`Enter`).
Stays `true` until that input ends anywhere on screen.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#press)
]]
local function press(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>
	return _pressWith(object, engineServices())
end

local function _selectedWith(object: GuiObject, env: Services?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	if env == nil then
		return expose(signal(false), object, function() end)
	end
	local guiService = env.GuiService
	local isSelected = signal(guiService.SelectedObject == object)
	local hub = registryFor(env).selected
	local function follow(on: any)
		isSelected:set(on == true)
	end
	hubAdd(hub, object, follow)

	return expose(isSelected, object, function()
		hubRemove(hub, object, follow)
		isSelected:set(false)
	end)
end

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `object` is currently [`GuiService.SelectedObject`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/GuiService#SelectedObject).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#selected)
]]
local function selected(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>
	return _selectedWith(object, engineServices())
end

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `textBox` currently has keyboard focus.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#focused)
]]
local function focused(textBox: TextBox): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local isFocused = signal(textBox:IsFocused())
	local onFocused = textBox.Focused:Connect(function()
		isFocused:set(true)
	end)
	local onFocusLost = textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		isFocused:set(false)
	end)
	local connections = { onFocused, onFocusLost }

	return expose(isFocused, textBox, function()
		dispose(connections)
		isFocused:set(false)
	end)
end

return table.freeze({
	pointIn = pointIn,
	sunk = sunk,
	covered = covered,

	hover = hover,
	press = press,
	selected = selected,
	focused = focused,

	--- @ignore
	_hoverWith = _hoverWith,
	--- @ignore
	_useHoverServices = useHoverServices,
	--- @ignore
	_pressWith = _pressWith,
	--- @ignore
	_selectedWith = _selectedWith,
})

--!strict
--[[
Layout instances with friendly, reactive arguments: `padding`, `corner`, `stroke`, `list`, `grid`, `flex`, `gradient`,
`aspectRatio`, `sizeConstraint`, `textSizeConstraint`. Each is flat on `Flux`.

```luau
Flux.new "Frame" { Flux.list { gap = 8, align = "center" }, Flux.corner(12) }
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Edit = require("./Edit")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local construct: (className: string, props: Props) -> any = Edit.new

local Color3 = Compat.Color3
local ColorSequence = Compat.ColorSequence
local ColorSequenceKeypoint = Compat.ColorSequenceKeypoint
local Enum = Compat.Enum
local NumberSequence = Compat.NumberSequence
local NumberSequenceKeypoint = Compat.NumberSequenceKeypoint
local UDim = Compat.UDim
local UDim2 = Compat.UDim2
local Vector2 = Compat.Vector2
local typeof = Compat.typeof
local warn = Compat.warn

local computed = Graph.computed
local isDynamic = Graph.isDynamic
local isNode = Graph.isNode
local new = Graph.new
local read: (source: any) -> any = Graph.read

--- @ignore
type Props = { [string]: any }
--- @ignore
type EnumMap = { [string]: EnumItem }

--- @ignore
export type Reactive<T> = Graph.Reactive<T>
export type Length = number | UDim
export type ReactiveLength = Reactive<number> | Reactive<UDim>
export type Insets = { top: number?, bottom: number?, left: number?, right: number? }
export type Align = "start" | "center" | "end"
export type FlexAlign = Align | "between" | "around" | "evenly" | "stretch" | "fill" | "none"
export type LineAlign = Align | "stretch" | "automatic"
export type Direction = "x" | "y"
export type FlexMode = "fill" | "grow" | "shrink" | "none"

export type PaddingSides = {
	top: ReactiveLength?,
	bottom: ReactiveLength?,
	left: ReactiveLength?,
	right: ReactiveLength?,
	x: ReactiveLength?,
	y: ReactiveLength?,
}

export type ListConfig = {
	gap: ReactiveLength?,
	direction: Reactive<Direction | Enum.FillDirection>?,
	align: Reactive<FlexAlign>?,
	justify: Reactive<FlexAlign>?,
	horizontalAlign: Reactive<FlexAlign | Enum.HorizontalAlignment | Enum.UIFlexAlignment>?,
	verticalAlign: Reactive<FlexAlign | Enum.VerticalAlignment | Enum.UIFlexAlignment>?,
	lineAlign: Reactive<LineAlign | Enum.ItemLineAlignment>?,
	wraps: Reactive<boolean>?,
}

export type GridConfig = {
	cell: Reactive<number | Vector2 | UDim2>?,
	gap: Reactive<number | Vector2 | UDim2>?,
	fill: Reactive<Direction | Enum.FillDirection>?,
	align: Reactive<Align | Enum.HorizontalAlignment>?,
	justify: Reactive<Align | Enum.VerticalAlignment>?,
	maxCells: Reactive<number>?,
}

export type StrokeConfig = {
	thickness: Reactive<number>?,
	color: Reactive<Color3>?,
	transparency: Reactive<number>?,
	mode: Reactive<"contextual" | "border" | Enum.ApplyStrokeMode>?,
	joins: Reactive<"round" | "bevel" | "miter" | Enum.LineJoinMode>?,
	position: Reactive<"inner" | "center" | "outer" | Enum.BorderStrokePosition>?,
	offset: Reactive<number | UDim>?,
}

export type CornerSides = {
	radius: ReactiveLength?,
	topLeft: ReactiveLength?,
	topRight: ReactiveLength?,
	bottomLeft: ReactiveLength?,
	bottomRight: ReactiveLength?,
	top: ReactiveLength?,
	bottom: ReactiveLength?,
	left: ReactiveLength?,
	right: ReactiveLength?,
}

export type GradientConfig = {
	color: Reactive<Color3 | ColorSequence | { Color3 }>?,
	transparency: Reactive<number | NumberSequence | { number }>?,
	rotation: Reactive<number>?,
	offset: Reactive<Vector2>?,
	enabled: Reactive<boolean>?,
}

export type SizeConstraintConfig = {
	min: Reactive<Vector2>?,
	max: Reactive<Vector2>?,
	minWidth: Reactive<number>?,
	minHeight: Reactive<number>?,
	maxWidth: Reactive<number>?,
	maxHeight: Reactive<number>?,
}

export type TextSizeConstraintConfig = {
	min: Reactive<number>?,
	max: Reactive<number>?,
}

local EMPTY: any = table.freeze({})
local ZERO_UDIM = UDim.new()
local SORT_ORDER = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
local FILL_DIRECTION: EnumMap = { x = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, y = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical }
local HORIZONTAL_ALIGN: EnumMap = {
	start = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
	center = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
	["end"] = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
}
local VERTICAL_ALIGN: EnumMap = {
	start = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
	center = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
	["end"] = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom,
}
local FLEX_ALIGNMENT: EnumMap = {
	none = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None,
	fill = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill,
	stretch = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill,
	between = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceBetween,
	around = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceAround,
	evenly = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceEvenly,
}
local ITEM_LINE_ALIGN: EnumMap = {
	automatic = Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Automatic,
	start = Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Start,
	center = Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Center,
	["end"] = Enum.ItemLineAlignment.End,
	stretch = Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Stretch,
}
local FLEX_MODE: EnumMap = {
	fill = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill,
	grow = Enum.UIFlexMode.Grow,
	shrink = Enum.UIFlexMode.Shrink,
	none = Enum.UIFlexMode.None,
}
local ASPECT_TYPE: EnumMap = {
	fit = Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize,
	scale = Enum.AspectType.ScaleWithParentSize,
}
local DOMINANT_AXIS: EnumMap = { width = Enum.DominantAxis.Width, height = Enum.DominantAxis.Height }
local STROKE_MODE: EnumMap = { contextual = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual, border = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }
local LINE_JOIN: EnumMap = {
	round = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
	bevel = Enum.LineJoinMode.Bevel,
	miter = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
}
local STROKE_POSITION: EnumMap = {
	inner = Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Inner,
	center = Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Center,
	outer = Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Outer,
}

local FLEX_ITEMS: { [EnumItem]: true } = {}
for _, item in FLEX_ALIGNMENT do
	FLEX_ITEMS[item] = true
end

local warnedEnums: { [string]: boolean } = {}

local function resolveEnum(map: EnumMap, value: any, label: string): any
	if value == nil then
		return nil
	elseif type(value) == "string" then
		local mapped = map[value]
		if mapped == nil then
			local key = `{label}:{value}`
			if not warnedEnums[key] then
				warnedEnums[key] = true
				warn(`[Flux] unknown {label} "{value}"; falling back to default`)
			end
			return nil
		end
		return mapped
	end
	return value
end

local function enumProp(map: EnumMap, value: any, label: string, default: EnumItem): any
	if isDynamic(value) then
		return function()
			local resolved = resolveEnum(map, read(value), label)
			return if resolved == nil then default else resolved
		end
	end
	return resolveEnum(map, value, label)
end

local function toUDim(value: any): UDim
	return if type(value) == "number" then UDim.new(0, value) else value
end

local function toUDim2(value: any): UDim2
	local kind = typeof(value)
	if kind == "Vector2" then
		return UDim2.fromOffset(value.X, value.Y)
	elseif kind == "number" then
		return UDim2.fromOffset(value, value)
	end
	return value
end

local function reactiveProp(value: any, convert: (any) -> any): any
	if isDynamic(value) then
		return function()
			return convert(read(value))
		end
	end
	return convert(value)
end

local function udimProp(value: any): any
	return reactiveProp(value, toUDim)
end

local function cornerProp(sides: CornerSides, corner: string, vertical: string, horizontal: string): any
	local entries: any = sides
	local value = entries[corner] or entries[vertical] or entries[horizontal] or sides.radius
	return udimProp(if value == nil then 8 else value)
end

local function spread(values: { any }, Keypoint: any, Sequence: any): any
	local count = #values
	if count == 1 then
		return Sequence.new(values[1])
	end
	local keypoints = table.create(count)
	for index, value in values do
		keypoints[index] = Keypoint.new((index - 1) / (count - 1), value)
	end
	return Sequence.new(keypoints)
end

local function toColorSequence(value: any): ColorSequence
	local kind = typeof(value)
	if kind == "ColorSequence" then
		return value
	elseif kind == "Color3" then
		return ColorSequence.new(value :: Color3)
	elseif kind == "table" and #value > 0 then
		return spread(value, ColorSequenceKeypoint, ColorSequence)
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
end

local function toNumberSequence(value: any): NumberSequence
	local kind = typeof(value)
	if kind == "NumberSequence" then
		return value
	elseif kind == "number" then
		return NumberSequence.new(value :: number)
	elseif kind == "table" and #value > 0 then
		return spread(value, NumberSequenceKeypoint, NumberSequence)
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(0)
end

local function toAxisPair(vector: any, x: any, y: any, fallback: number): Vector2
	local base = read(vector)
	local width, height = read(x), read(y)
	return Vector2.new(
		if width ~= nil then width elseif base ~= nil then base.X else fallback,
		if height ~= nil then height elseif base ~= nil then base.Y else fallback
	)
end

local function axisPair(vector: any, x: any, y: any, fallback: number): any
	if vector == nil and x == nil and y == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if isDynamic(vector) or isDynamic(x) or isDynamic(y) then
		return function(): Vector2
			return toAxisPair(vector, x, y, fallback)
		end
	end
	return toAxisPair(vector, x, y, fallback)
end

local function setSide(props: Props, prop: string, value: any)
	if value ~= nil then
		props[prop] = udimProp(value)
	end
end

local function paddingSide(source: any, field: string, axis: string): () -> UDim
	return function()
		local value = read(source)
		if typeof(value) == "table" then
			return toUDim(value[field] or value[axis] or 0)
		elseif value == nil then
			return ZERO_UDIM
		end
		return toUDim(value)
	end
end

local function toFlexAlignment(value: any): EnumItem?
	if type(value) == "string" then
		return FLEX_ALIGNMENT[value]
	end
	return if FLEX_ITEMS[value] then value else nil
end

local function readListAlign(
	pinned: any,
	direction: any,
	align: any,
	justify: any,
	axis: Direction,
	label: string
): (any, string)
	if pinned ~= nil then
		local override = read(pinned)
		if override ~= nil then
			return override, label
		end
	end
	local main = read(direction) == FILL_DIRECTION.x
	if (axis == "x") == main then
		return read(justify), "justify"
	end
	return read(align), "align"
end

local function listAlign(cfg: ListConfig, direction: any, axis: Direction, map: EnumMap, label: string): (any, any)
	local pinned = if axis == "x" then cfg.horizontalAlign else cfg.verticalAlign
	local align, justify = cfg.align, cfg.justify

	if pinned == nil and align == nil and justify == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local reactive: boolean
	if pinned ~= nil then
		reactive = isDynamic(pinned)
	elseif isDynamic(direction) then
		reactive = true
	else
		local active = if (axis == "x") == (direction == FILL_DIRECTION.x) then justify else align
		if active == nil then
			return nil, nil
		end
		reactive = isDynamic(active)
	end
	if reactive then
		return function()
			local v, source = readListAlign(pinned, direction, align, justify, axis, label)
			return if toFlexAlignment(v) ~= nil then map.start else resolveEnum(map, v, source) or map.start
		end, function()
			local v, _ = readListAlign(pinned, direction, align, justify, axis, label)
			return toFlexAlignment(v) or FLEX_ALIGNMENT.none
		end
	end

	local v, source = readListAlign(pinned, direction, align, justify, axis, label)
	local flex = toFlexAlignment(v)
	if flex ~= nil then
		return map.start, flex
	end
	return resolveEnum(map, v, source), nil
end

local Layout = {}

--[[
Creates a [`UIPadding`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIPadding) from a single length, a `{ top, bottom, left, right, x, y }` table, or a reactive source.
Plain `number` values are interpreted as offset pixels.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#padding)
]]
function Layout.padding(value: Length | PaddingSides | Graph.Node<any> | (() -> Length | Insets)): UIPadding
	local props: Props = {}

	if isDynamic(value) then
		local rawValue: any = value
		local source: any = new(rawValue)
		props.PaddingTop = paddingSide(source, "top", "y")
		props.PaddingBottom = paddingSide(source, "bottom", "y")
		props.PaddingLeft = paddingSide(source, "left", "x")
		props.PaddingRight = paddingSide(source, "right", "x")
		if source ~= value then
			props.__CLEAN = { source }
		end
	elseif typeof(value) == "table" then
		local sides = value :: PaddingSides
		setSide(props, "PaddingTop", sides.top or sides.y)
		setSide(props, "PaddingBottom", sides.bottom or sides.y)
		setSide(props, "PaddingLeft", sides.left or sides.x)
		setSide(props, "PaddingRight", sides.right or sides.x)
	else
		local side = udimProp(value)
		props.PaddingTop, props.PaddingBottom, props.PaddingLeft, props.PaddingRight = side, side, side, side
	end

	return construct("UIPadding", props)
end

--[[
Creates a [`UICorner`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UICorner) from an offset pixel radius, a [`UDim`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/UDim), or a per-corner `{ topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight, top, bottom, left, right, radius }` table.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#corner)
]]
function Layout.corner(radius: ReactiveLength | CornerSides?): UICorner
	local rawRadius: any = radius
	if type(radius) == "table" and not isNode(radius) and rawRadius.Offset == nil then
		local sides: CornerSides = rawRadius
		return construct("UICorner", {
			TopLeftRadius = cornerProp(sides, "topLeft", "top", "left"),
			TopRightRadius = cornerProp(sides, "topRight", "top", "right"),
			BottomLeftRadius = cornerProp(sides, "bottomLeft", "bottom", "left"),
			BottomRightRadius = cornerProp(sides, "bottomRight", "bottom", "right"),
		})
	end
	return construct("UICorner", { CornerRadius = udimProp(radius) })
end

--[[
Creates a [`UIStroke`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIStroke) with static or reactive `thickness`, `color`, `transparency`, `mode`, `joins`, `position`, and `offset`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#stroke)
]]
function Layout.stroke(config: StrokeConfig?): UIStroke
	local cfg: StrokeConfig = config or EMPTY
	return construct("UIStroke", {
		Thickness = cfg.thickness,
		Color = cfg.color,
		Transparency = cfg.transparency,
		ApplyStrokeMode = enumProp(STROKE_MODE, cfg.mode, "strokeMode", STROKE_MODE.contextual),
		LineJoinMode = enumProp(LINE_JOIN, cfg.joins, "lineJoin", LINE_JOIN.round),
		BorderStrokePosition = if cfg.position ~= nil
			then enumProp(STROKE_POSITION, cfg.position, "strokePosition", STROKE_POSITION.outer)
			else nil,
		BorderOffset = if cfg.offset ~= nil then udimProp(cfg.offset) else nil,
	})
end

--[[
Creates a [`UIAspectRatioConstraint`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIAspectRatioConstraint) with `ratio`, `aspectType` (`"fit"` or `"scale"`), and `dominantAxis` (`"width"` or `"height"`).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#aspectratio)
]]
function Layout.aspectRatio(
	ratio: Reactive<number>,
	aspectType: Reactive<"fit" | "scale" | Enum.AspectType>?,
	dominantAxis: Reactive<"width" | "height" | Enum.DominantAxis>?
): UIAspectRatioConstraint
	return construct("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {
		AspectRatio = ratio,
		AspectType = enumProp(ASPECT_TYPE, aspectType, "aspectType", ASPECT_TYPE.fit),
		DominantAxis = enumProp(DOMINANT_AXIS, dominantAxis, "dominantAxis", DOMINANT_AXIS.width),
	})
end

--[[
Creates a [`UIListLayout`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIListLayout) with `SortOrder = LayoutOrder` and flexbox-style `gap`, `direction`, `align` (cross-axis), `justify` (main-axis), and `wraps` options.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#list)
]]
function Layout.list(config: ListConfig?): UIListLayout
	local cfg: ListConfig = config or EMPTY
	local props: Props = {
		SortOrder = SORT_ORDER,
		Padding = udimProp(cfg.gap),
		Wraps = cfg.wraps,
		ItemLineAlignment = enumProp(ITEM_LINE_ALIGN, cfg.lineAlign, "lineAlign", ITEM_LINE_ALIGN.automatic),
	}

	local direction: any = cfg.direction
	if isDynamic(direction) then
		local source = direction
		direction = computed(function()
			return resolveEnum(FILL_DIRECTION, read(source), "direction") or FILL_DIRECTION.y
		end)
		props.__CLEAN = { direction }
	else
		direction = resolveEnum(FILL_DIRECTION, direction, "direction")
	end
	props.FillDirection = direction

	props.HorizontalAlignment, props.HorizontalFlex =
		listAlign(cfg, direction, "x", HORIZONTAL_ALIGN, "horizontalAlign")
	props.VerticalAlignment, props.VerticalFlex = listAlign(cfg, direction, "y", VERTICAL_ALIGN, "verticalAlign")

	return construct("UIListLayout", props)
end

--[[
Creates a [`UIGridLayout`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIGridLayout) with `SortOrder = LayoutOrder` and `cell`, `gap`, `fill`, `align`, `justify`, and `maxCells` options.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#grid)
]]
function Layout.grid(config: GridConfig?): UIGridLayout
	local cfg: GridConfig = config or EMPTY
	return construct("UIGridLayout", {
		SortOrder = SORT_ORDER,
		CellSize = reactiveProp(cfg.cell, toUDim2),
		CellPadding = reactiveProp(cfg.gap, toUDim2),
		FillDirectionMaxCells = cfg.maxCells,
		FillDirection = enumProp(FILL_DIRECTION, cfg.fill, "fill", FILL_DIRECTION.x),
		HorizontalAlignment = enumProp(HORIZONTAL_ALIGN, cfg.align, "align", HORIZONTAL_ALIGN.start),
		VerticalAlignment = enumProp(VERTICAL_ALIGN, cfg.justify, "justify", VERTICAL_ALIGN.start),
	})
end

--[[
Creates a [`UIFlexItem`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIFlexItem) with `mode` (`"fill"` by default, `"grow"`, `"shrink"`, or `"none"`).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#flex)
]]
function Layout.flex(mode: Reactive<FlexMode | Enum.UIFlexMode>?): UIFlexItem
	if isDynamic(mode) then
		return construct("UIFlexItem", {
			FlexMode = function()
				local value = read(mode)
				return if value == nil
					then FLEX_MODE.fill
					else resolveEnum(FLEX_MODE, value, "flexMode") or FLEX_MODE.none
			end,
		})
	end
	return construct("UIFlexItem", {
		FlexMode = if mode == nil then FLEX_MODE.fill else resolveEnum(FLEX_MODE, mode, "flexMode"),
	})
end

--[[
Creates a [`UIGradient`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/UIGradient) from single values, evenly spaced stop arrays, or sequences for `color` and `transparency`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/layout#gradient)
]]
function Layout.gradient(config: GradientConfig?): UIGradient
	local cfg: GradientConfig = config or EMPTY
	return construct("UIGradient", {
		Color = if cfg.color ~= nil then reactiveProp(cfg.color, toColorSequence) else nil,
		Transparency = if cfg.transparency ~= nil then reactiveProp(cfg.transparency, toNumberSequence) else nil,
		Rotation = cfg.rotation,
		Offset = cfg.offset,
		Enabled = cfg.enabled,
	})
end

-- Color & Oklab -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function fromLinear(c: number): number
	return if c < 0.0031308 then c * 12.92 else c ^ (1 / 2.4) * 1.055 - 0.055
end

local function toLinear(c: number): number
	return if c < 0.04045 then c / 12.92 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
end

local sRGB = table.freeze({
	--- Converts linear sRGB space to sRGB space.
	fromLinear = function(color: Color3): Color3
		return Color3.new(fromLinear(color.R), fromLinear(color.G), fromLinear(color.B))
	end,
	--- Converts sRGB space to linear sRGB space.
	toLinear = function(color: Color3): Color3
		return Color3.new(toLinear(color.R), toLinear(color.G), toLinear(color.B))
	end,
})

local function oklabToLinearRGB(L: number, A: number, B: number): (number, number, number)
	local l_ = L + 0.3963377774 * A + 0.2158037573 * B
	local m_ = L - 0.1055613458 * A - 0.0638541728 * B
	local s_ = L - 0.0894841775 * A - 1.2914855480 * B
	local l, m, s = l_ * l_ * l_, m_ * m_ * m_, s_ * s_ * s_
	return 4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s,
		-1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s,
		-0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.7076147010 * s
end

local GAMUT_SLACK = 1e-5

local function cbrt(x: number): number
	return if x >= 0 then x ^ (1 / 3) else -((-x) ^ (1 / 3))
end

local function linearToOklab(R: number, G: number, B: number): (number, number, number)
	local l_ = cbrt(R * 0.4122214708 + G * 0.5363325363 + B * 0.0514459929)
	local m_ = cbrt(R * 0.2119034982 + G * 0.6806995451 + B * 0.1073969566)
	local s_ = cbrt(R * 0.0883024619 + G * 0.2817188376 + B * 0.6299787005)
	return l_ * 0.2104542553 + m_ * 0.7936177850 - s_ * 0.0040720468,
		l_ * 1.9779984951 - m_ * 2.4285922050 + s_ * 0.4505937099,
		l_ * 0.0259040371 + m_ * 0.7827717662 - s_ * 0.8086757660
end

local function rgbToOklab(rgb: Color3): (number, number, number)
	return linearToOklab(toLinear(rgb.R), toLinear(rgb.G), toLinear(rgb.B))
end

local function oklabComponentsToLinear(L: number, A: number, B: number, clamped: boolean?): (number, number, number)
	local r, g, b = oklabToLinearRGB(L, A, B)
	if clamped ~= false and (r < 0 or g < 0 or b < 0 or r > 1 or g > 1 or b > 1) then
		if
			r >= -GAMUT_SLACK
			and g >= -GAMUT_SLACK
			and b >= -GAMUT_SLACK
			and r <= 1 + GAMUT_SLACK
			and g <= 1 + GAMUT_SLACK
			and b <= 1 + GAMUT_SLACK
		then
			return math.clamp(r, 0, 1), math.clamp(g, 0, 1), math.clamp(b, 0, 1)
		end
		local L0 = math.clamp(L, 0, 1)
		local lo, hi = 0, 1
		for _ = 1, 12 do
			local mid = (lo + hi) / 2
			local mr, mg, mb = oklabToLinearRGB(L0, A * mid, B * mid)
			if mr >= 0 and mg >= 0 and mb >= 0 and mr <= 1 and mg <= 1 and mb <= 1 then
				lo = mid
			else
				hi = mid
			end
		end
		r, g, b = oklabToLinearRGB(L0, A * lo, B * lo)
	end
	return r, g, b
end

local function oklabToSRGB(L: number, A: number, B: number, clamped: boolean?): Color3
	local r, g, b = oklabComponentsToLinear(L, A, B, clamped)
	return Color3.new(fromLinear(r), fromLinear(g), fromLinear(b))
end

local function saturateAB(a: number, b: number, amount: number): (number, number)
	local c = math.sqrt(a * a + b * b)
	if c < 1e-6 then
		return a, b
	end
	local scale = math.max(c + amount, 0) / c
	return a * scale, b * scale
end

local function rotateAB(a: number, b: number, degrees: number): (number, number)
	local r = math.rad(degrees)
	local cos, sin = math.cos(r), math.sin(r)
	return a * cos - b * sin, a * sin + b * cos
end

local Oklab = table.freeze({
	--- Converts a Color3 in linear sRGB space to a Vector3 in Oklab space.
	fromLinear = function(color: Color3): Vector3
		return Vector3.new(linearToOklab(color.R, color.G, color.B))
	end,
	--- Converts a Vector3 in Oklab space to a Color3 in linear sRGB space.
	toLinear = function(color: Vector3, clamped: boolean?): Color3
		return Color3.new(oklabComponentsToLinear(color.X, color.Y, color.Z, clamped))
	end,
	--- Converts a Color3 in sRGB space to a Vector3 in Oklab space.
	fromRGB = function(rgb: Color3): Vector3
		return Vector3.new(rgbToOklab(rgb))
	end,
	--- Converts a Vector3 in Oklab space to a Color3 in sRGB space.
	toRGB = function(lab: Vector3, clamped: boolean?): Color3
		return oklabToSRGB(lab.X, lab.Y, lab.Z, clamped)
	end,
	--- Raises Oklab lightness by `amount` (negative darkens).
	lighten = function(lab: Vector3, amount: number): Vector3
		return Vector3.new(math.clamp(lab.X + amount, 0, 1), lab.Y, lab.Z)
	end,
	--- Raises Oklab chroma by `amount`, preserving hue and lightness (negative desaturates).
	saturate = function(lab: Vector3, amount: number): Vector3
		local a, b = saturateAB(lab.Y, lab.Z, amount)
		return if a == lab.Y and b == lab.Z then lab else Vector3.new(lab.X, a, b)
	end,
	--- Rotates hue by `degrees`, preserving chroma and lightness.
	rotateHue = function(lab: Vector3, degrees: number): Vector3
		local a, b = rotateAB(lab.Y, lab.Z, degrees)
		return Vector3.new(lab.X, a, b)
	end,
	--- Removes all chroma, preserving Oklab lightness.
	grayscale = function(lab: Vector3): Vector3
		return Vector3.new(lab.X, 0, 0)
	end,
	--- Linearly interpolates between `lab1` and `lab2` in Oklab space by `alpha`.
	mix = function(lab1: Vector3, lab2: Vector3, alpha: number): Vector3
		return lab1:Lerp(lab2, alpha)
	end,
})

local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local function luminance(c: Color3): number
	return 0.2126 * toLinear(c.R) + 0.7152 * toLinear(c.G) + 0.0722 * toLinear(c.B)
end

local function contrastLuminance(la: number, lb: number): number
	return (math.max(la, lb) + 0.05) / (math.min(la, lb) + 0.05)
end

local Color = table.freeze({
	Oklab = Oklab,
	sRGB = sRGB,
	--[[
	Raises the perceptual lightness of `c` in Oklab space by `amount` (negative darkens).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#manipulation)
	]]
	lighten = function(c: Color3, amount: number): Color3
		local L, a, b = rgbToOklab(c)
		return oklabToSRGB(math.clamp(L + amount, 0, 1), a, b)
	end,
	--[[
	Raises the chroma of `c` in Oklab space by `amount` while preserving hue and lightness (negative desaturates).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#manipulation)
	]]
	saturate = function(c: Color3, amount: number): Color3
		local L, a, b = rgbToOklab(c)
		a, b = saturateAB(a, b, amount)
		return oklabToSRGB(L, a, b)
	end,
	--[[
	Rotates the hue of `c` by `degrees` around the Oklab color wheel while preserving chroma and lightness.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#manipulation)
	]]
	rotateHue = function(c: Color3, degrees: number): Color3
		local L, a, b = rgbToOklab(c)
		a, b = rotateAB(a, b, degrees)
		return oklabToSRGB(L, a, b)
	end,
	--[[
	Strips all chroma from `c`, returning a neutral gray with the same Oklab perceptual lightness.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#manipulation)
	]]
	grayscale = function(c: Color3): Color3
		local L = rgbToOklab(c)
		return oklabToSRGB(L, 0, 0)
	end,
	--[[
	Blends `a` and `b` in Oklab space by unclamped fraction `t` (`0` = `a`, `1` = `b`).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#blending)
	]]
	mix = function(a: Color3, b: Color3, t: number): Color3
		local L1, a1, b1 = rgbToOklab(a)
		local L2, a2, b2 = rgbToOklab(b)
		return oklabToSRGB(L1 + (L2 - L1) * t, a1 + (a2 - a1) * t, b1 + (b2 - b1) * t)
	end,
	--[[
	Returns the WCAG relative luminance of `c` from `0` (black) to `1` (white).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#accessibility)
	]]
	luminance = luminance,
	--[[
	Returns the WCAG contrast ratio between `a` and `b` from `1` (identical) to `21` (black on white).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#accessibility)
	]]
	contrast = function(a: Color3, b: Color3): number
		return contrastLuminance(luminance(a), luminance(b))
	end,
	--[[
	Returns whichever of `dark` (default black) or `light` (default white) has the higher WCAG contrast ratio against `bg`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color#accessibility)
	]]
	readable = function(bg: Color3, dark: Color3?, light: Color3?): Color3
		local d = dark or BLACK
		local l = light or WHITE
		local lBg = luminance(bg)
		return if contrastLuminance(lBg, luminance(d)) >= contrastLuminance(lBg, luminance(l)) then d else l
	end,
})

export type Animatable =

local round = math.round
local math_max = math.max
local CFrame_new = CFrame.new
local CFrame_fromAxisAngle = CFrame.fromAxisAngle
local Color3_new = Color3.new
local ColorSequence_new = ColorSequence.new
local ColorSequenceKeypoint_new = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
local NumberRange_new = NumberRange.new
local NumberSequence_new = NumberSequence.new
local NumberSequenceKeypoint_new = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new

local UDim2_new = UDim2.new
