local Vector3_new = Vector3.new

local function Oklab_toRGB(L: number, A: number, B: number, clamped: boolean): Color3
	local r, g, b = oklabComponentsToLinear(L, A, B, clamped)
	return Color3_new(math_max(fromLinear(r), 0), math_max(fromLinear(g), 0), math_max(fromLinear(b), 0))
end

local packers: { [string]: ({ number }, any) -> () } = {
	number = function(v, value: number)
		v[1] = value
	end,
	vector = function(v, value: vector)
		v[1], v[2], v[3] = value.x, value.y, value.z
	end,
	Color3 = function(t, v: Color3)
		t[1], t[2], t[3] = rgbToOklab(v)
	end,
	ColorSequence = function(t, v: ColorSequence)
		for i, k in v.Keypoints do
			local base = (i - 1) * 4
			t[base + 1], t[base + 2], t[base + 3], t[base + 4] = k.Time, rgbToOklab(k.Value)
		end
	end,
	ColorSequenceKeypoint = function(t, v: ColorSequenceKeypoint)
		t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4] = v.Time, rgbToOklab(v.Value)
	end,
	NumberSequence = function(t, v: NumberSequence)
		for i, k in v.Keypoints do
			local base = (i - 1) * 3
			t[base + 1], t[base + 2], t[base + 3] = k.Time, k.Value, k.Envelope
		end
	end,
	NumberSequenceKeypoint = function(t, v: NumberSequenceKeypoint)
		t[1], t[2], t[3] = v.Time, v.Value, v.Envelope
	end,
	CFrame = function(t, v: CFrame)
		local p, a = v:ToAxisAngle()
		t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5], t[6] = v.X, v.Y, v.Z, p.X * a, p.Y * a, p.Z * a
	end,
	NumberRange = function(t, v: NumberRange)
		t[1], t[2] = v.Min, v.Max
	end,
	Rect = function(t, v: Rect)
		t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4] = v.Min.X, v.Min.Y, v.Max.X, v.Max.Y
	end,
	UDim = function(t, v: UDim)
		t[1], t[2] = v.Scale, v.Offset
	end,
	UDim2 = function(t, v: UDim2)
		t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4] = v.X.Scale, v.X.Offset, v.Y.Scale, v.Y.Offset
	end,
	Vector2 = function(t, v: Vector2)
		t[1], t[2] = v.X, v.Y
	end,
	Vector3 = function(t, v: Vector3)
		t[1], t[2], t[3] = v.X, v.Y, v.Z
	end,
}

local unpackers: { [string]: ({ number }) -> any } = {
	number = function(v): number
		return v[1]
	end,
	vector = function(v): vector
		return vector.create(v[1], v[2], v[3])
	end,
	CFrame = function(t): CFrame
		local p = CFrame_new(t[1], t[2], t[3])
		local rx, ry, rz = t[4], t[5], t[6]
		local a = math.sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz)
		return if a < 1e-6 then p else p * CFrame_fromAxisAngle(Vector3_new(rx / a, ry / a, rz / a), a)
	end,
	Color3 = function(t): Color3
		return Oklab_toRGB(t[1], t[2], t[3], false)
	end,
	ColorSequence = function(t): ColorSequence
		local n = #t // 4
		local k = table.create(n) :: { ColorSequenceKeypoint }
		local prevTime = 0
		for idx = 1, n do
			local base = (idx - 1) * 4
			local time = if idx == 1 then 0 elseif idx == n then 1 else math.clamp(t[base + 1], prevTime, 1)
			prevTime = time
			k[idx] = ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(time, Oklab_toRGB(t[base + 2], t[base + 3], t[base + 4], true))
		end
		return ColorSequence_new(k)
	end,
	ColorSequenceKeypoint = function(t): ColorSequenceKeypoint
		return ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(math.clamp(t[1], 0, 1), Oklab_toRGB(t[2], t[3], t[4], false))
	end,
	NumberRange = function(t): NumberRange
		local min, max = t[1], t[2]
		return NumberRange_new(min, math_max(min, max))
	end,
	NumberSequence = function(t): NumberSequence
		local n = #t // 3
		local k = table.create(n) :: { NumberSequenceKeypoint }
		local prevTime = 0
		for idx = 1, n do
			local base = (idx - 1) * 3
			local time = if idx == 1 then 0 elseif idx == n then 1 else math.clamp(t[base + 1], prevTime, 1)
			prevTime = time
			k[idx] = NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(time, t[base + 2], math_max(t[base + 3], 0))
		end
		return NumberSequence_new(k)
	end,
	NumberSequenceKeypoint = function(t): NumberSequenceKeypoint
		return NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(math.clamp(t[1], 0, 1), t[2], math_max(t[3], 0))
	end,
	Rect = function(t): Rect
		local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4]
		return Rect_new(minX, minY, maxX, maxY)
	end,
	UDim = function(t): UDim
		return UDim_new(t[1], round(t[2]))
	end,
	UDim2 = function(t): UDim2
		return UDim2_new(t[1], round(t[2]), t[3], round(t[4]))
	end,
	Vector2 = function(t): Vector2
		return Vector2_new(t[1], t[2])
	end,
	Vector3 = function(t): Vector3
		return Vector3_new(t[1], t[2], t[3])
	end,
}

local function pack(arr: { number }, value: Animatable, t: string)
	table.clear(arr)
	local packer = packers[t]
	if packer then
		packer(arr, value)
	end
	return arr
end

-- Easing --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- @ignore
export type Curve = (alpha: number) -> number

local sin, cos, sqrt, pi = math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.pi
local BACK = 1.70158

local function bounceOut(t: number): number
	if t < 1 / 2.75 then
		return 7.5625 * t * t
	elseif t < 2 / 2.75 then
		t -= 1.5 / 2.75
		return 7.5625 * t * t + 0.75
	elseif t < 2.5 / 2.75 then
		t -= 2.25 / 2.75
		return 7.5625 * t * t + 0.9375
	else
		t -= 2.625 / 2.75
		return 7.5625 * t * t + 0.984375
	end
end

local curves: { [string]: { In: Curve, Out: Curve, InOut: Curve? } } = {
	Linear = {
		In = function(t)
			return t
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			return t
		end,
	},
	Sine = {
		In = function(t)
			return 1 - cos(t * pi / 2)
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			return sin(t * pi / 2)
		end,
		InOut = function(t)
			return (1 - cos(t * pi)) / 2
		end,
	},
	Quad = {
		In = function(t)
			return t * t
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			t = 1 - t
			return 1 - t * t
		end,
	},
	Cubic = {
		In = function(t)
			return t * t * t
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			t = 1 - t
			return 1 - t * t * t
		end,
	},
	Quart = {
		In = function(t)
			t *= t
			return t * t
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			t = 1 - t
			t *= t
			return 1 - t * t
		end,
	},
	Quint = {
		In = function(t)
			local t2 = t * t
			return t2 * t2 * t
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			t = 1 - t
			local t2 = t * t
			return 1 - t2 * t2 * t
		end,
	},
	Exponential = {
		In = function(t)
			return if t == 0 then 0 else 2 ^ (10 * t - 10)
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			return if t == 1 then 1 else 1 - 2 ^ (-10 * t)
		end,
	},
	Circular = {
		In = function(t)
			return 1 - sqrt(1 - t * t)
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			t = 1 - t
			return sqrt(1 - t * t)
		end,
	},
	Back = {
		In = function(t)
			return t * t * ((BACK + 1) * t - BACK)
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			t -= 1
			return 1 + t * t * ((BACK + 1) * t + BACK)
		end,
	},
	Elastic = {
		In = function(t)
			if t == 0 or t == 1 then
				return t
			end
			t = 1 - t
			return 2 ^ (-10 * t) * cos(6.5 * pi * t)
		end,
		Out = function(t)
			if t == 0 or t == 1 then
				return t
			end
			return 1 - 2 ^ (-10 * t) * cos(6.5 * pi * t)
		end,
	},
	Bounce = {
		In = function(t)
			return 1 - bounceOut(1 - t)
		end,
		Out = bounceOut,
	},
}

local function inOut(easeIn: Curve, easeOut: Curve): Curve
	return function(t)
		return if t < 0.5 then easeIn(2 * t) / 2 else (1 + easeOut(2 * t - 1)) / 2
	end
end

local styles: { [any]: { [any]: Curve } } = {}
local easingDirection: any = if Enum then Enum.EasingDirection else nil
local easingStyle: any = if Enum then Enum.EasingStyle else nil
local DIRECTIONS = { "In", "Out", "InOut" }
for name, set in curves do
	local byDirection: { [any]: Curve } = {
		In = set.In,
		Out = set.Out,
		InOut = set.InOut or inOut(set.In, set.Out),
	}
	if easingDirection then
		for _, direction in DIRECTIONS do
			byDirection[easingDirection[direction]] = byDirection[direction]
		end
		styles[easingStyle[name]] = byDirection
	end
	styles[name] = byDirection
end

local function itemKey(item: any): any
	return if type(item) == "string" then item else item.Name
end

local Easing = {}

function Easing.curve(style: any, direction: any): Curve
	local byDirection = styles[style] or styles[itemKey(style)]
	if byDirection == nil then
		error(`Unknown EasingStyle {tostring(style)}`, 2)
	end
	local curve = byDirection[direction] or byDirection[itemKey(direction)]
	if curve == nil then
		error(`Unknown EasingDirection {tostring(direction)}`, 2)
	end
	return curve
end

function Easing.get(alpha: number, style: any, direction: any): number
	return Easing.curve(style, direction)(math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1))
end

table.freeze(Easing)

-- Engine --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local lastClock = clock()

local TYPE_TWEEN = 1
local TYPE_SPRING = 2
local EPSILON = 1e-4

--- @ignore
export type Motion = {
	type: number,
	count: number,
	node: Graph.Node<any>,
	typeString: string,
	unpack: ({ number }) -> any,
	target: { number },
	value: { number },
}

--- @ignore
export type EngineSpring = Motion & {
	vel: { number },
	frequency: number,
	damping: number,
}

--- @ignore
export type Tween = Motion & {
	info: TweenInfo,
	ease: Curve,
	startTime: number,
	repeatsLeft: number,
	reversing: boolean,
	start: { number },
}

local activeSprings: { [Motion]: any } = {}
local activeTweens: { [Motion]: any } = {}

local Engine = {
	now = 0,
	DEFAULT_TWEEN_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
	isActive = function(motion: EngineSpring | Tween): boolean
		return activeSprings[motion] ~= nil or activeTweens[motion] ~= nil
	end,
}

function Engine.newSpring(
	count: number,
	typeString: string,
	node: any,
	frequency: number?,
	damping: number?
): EngineSpring
	return {
		type = TYPE_SPRING,
		count = count,
		node = node,
		typeString = typeString,
		unpack = unpackers[typeString],
		target = table.create(count, 0),
		value = table.create(count, 0),
		vel = table.create(count, 0),
		frequency = math.max(frequency or 1, EPSILON),
		damping = math.max(damping or 1, EPSILON),
	}
end

function Engine.newTween(count: number, typeString: string, node: any, tweenInfo: TweenInfo?): Tween
	local info = tweenInfo or Engine.DEFAULT_TWEEN_INFO
	return {
		type = TYPE_TWEEN,
		count = count,
		node = node,
		typeString = typeString,
		unpack = unpackers[typeString],
		start = table.create(count, 0),
		target = table.create(count, 0),
		value = table.create(count, 0),
		info = info,
		ease = Easing.curve(info.EasingStyle, info.EasingDirection),
		startTime = Engine.now + info.DelayTime,
		repeatsLeft = info.RepeatCount,
		reversing = false,
	}
end

function Engine.destroy(motion: EngineSpring | Tween)
	activeSprings[motion] = nil
	activeTweens[motion] = nil
	table.clear(motion)
end

function Engine.setupSpring(spring: EngineSpring, frequency: number?, damping: number?)
	spring.frequency = math.max(frequency or 1, EPSILON)
	spring.damping = math.max(damping or 1, EPSILON)
	activeSprings[spring] = spring.node
end

function Engine.setupTween(tween: Tween, tweenInfo: TweenInfo?)
	local info = tweenInfo or Engine.DEFAULT_TWEEN_INFO
	tween.info = info
	tween.ease = Easing.curve(info.EasingStyle, info.EasingDirection)
	tween.startTime = Engine.now + info.DelayTime
	tween.repeatsLeft = info.RepeatCount
	tween.reversing = false
	local start, value = tween.start, tween.value
	table.move(value, 1, #value, 1, start)
	activeTweens[tween] = tween.node
end

function Engine.snap(motion: EngineSpring | Tween, arr: { number })
	local n = #arr
	local target, value = motion.target, motion.value
	table.clear(target)
	table.clear(value)
	table.move(arr, 1, n, 1, target)
	table.move(arr, 1, n, 1, value)
	if motion.type == TYPE_TWEEN then
		local start = (motion :: Tween).start
		table.clear(start)
		table.move(arr, 1, n, 1, start)
	else
		local vel = (motion :: EngineSpring).vel
		table.clear(vel)
		for i = 1, n do
			vel[i] = 0
		end
	end
	motion.count = n
	activeSprings[motion] = nil
	activeTweens[motion] = nil
end

function Engine.setTarget(motion: EngineSpring | Tween, arr: { number })
	local activeMap = if motion.type == TYPE_TWEEN then activeTweens else activeSprings
	local n = #arr
	if n ~= motion.count then
		Engine.snap(motion, arr)
		activeMap[motion] = motion.node
		return
	end

	local target = motion.target
	local changed = false
	for i, v in arr do
		if target[i] ~= v then
			changed = true
			target[i] = v
		end
	end
	if not changed then
		return
	end

	if motion.type == TYPE_TWEEN then
		motion = motion :: Tween
		table.move(motion.value, 1, n, 1, motion.start)
		motion.startTime = Engine.now
		motion.repeatsLeft = motion.info.RepeatCount
		motion.reversing = false
	end
	activeMap[motion] = motion.node
end

function Engine.addVelocity(spring: EngineSpring, arr: { number })
	local vel = spring.vel
	for i = 1, math.min(#arr, spring.count) do
		vel[i] += arr[i]
	end
	activeSprings[spring] = spring.node
end

function Engine.setVelocity(spring: EngineSpring, arr: { number })
	local vel = spring.vel
	for i = 1, math.min(#arr, spring.count) do
		vel[i] = arr[i]
	end
	activeSprings[spring] = spring.node
end

local function stepSpring(motion: EngineSpring, dt: number)
	local f, d = motion.frequency, motion.damping
	local w = math.tau * f
	local isSleeping = true
	local target, value, m_vel = motion.target, motion.value, motion.vel

	if d == 1 then
		local expTerm = math.exp(-w * dt)
		for c, pos in value do
			local tar, vel = target[c], m_vel[c]
			local c1 = pos - tar
			if math.abs(c1) > EPSILON or math.abs(vel) > EPSILON then
				isSleeping = false
				local c2 = vel + w * c1
				local positionTerm = c1 + c2 * dt
				value[c] = tar + positionTerm * expTerm
				m_vel[c] = (c2 - w * positionTerm) * expTerm
			end
		end
	elseif d < 1 then
		local wd = w * math.sqrt(1 - d * d)
		local dampingRate = w * d
		local expTerm = math.exp(-dampingRate * dt)
		local phase = wd * dt
		local cosTerm, sinTerm = math.cos(phase), math.sin(phase)
		for c, pos in value do
			local tar, vel = target[c], m_vel[c]
			local c1 = pos - tar
			if math.abs(c1) > EPSILON or math.abs(vel) > EPSILON then
				isSleeping = false
				local c2 = (vel + dampingRate * c1) / wd
				value[c] = tar + expTerm * (c1 * cosTerm + c2 * sinTerm)
				m_vel[c] = expTerm * (vel * cosTerm - (c1 * wd + c2 * dampingRate) * sinTerm)
			end
		end
	else
		local wd = w * math.sqrt(d * d - 1)
		local negDampingRate = -w * d
		local r1, r2 = negDampingRate + wd, negDampingRate - wd
		local rDiff = r2 - r1
		local exp1, exp2 = math.exp(r1 * dt), math.exp(r2 * dt)
		for c, pos in value do
			local tar, vel = target[c], m_vel[c]
			local displacement = pos - tar
			if math.abs(displacement) > EPSILON or math.abs(vel) > EPSILON then
				isSleeping = false
				local c2 = (vel - r1 * displacement) / rDiff
				local c1 = displacement - c2
				value[c] = tar + c1 * exp1 + c2 * exp2
				m_vel[c] = c1 * r1 * exp1 + c2 * r2 * exp2
			end
		end
	end

	if isSleeping then
		for c, tar in target do
			value[c] = tar
			m_vel[c] = 0
		end
		activeSprings[motion] = nil
	end
end

local function stepTween(tween: Tween, now: number)
	local elapsed = now - tween.startTime
	if elapsed < 0 then
		return
	end
	local tInfo = tween.info
	local duration = tInfo.Time
	local alpha = if duration > 0 then elapsed / duration else 1

	while alpha >= 1 do
		if tInfo.Reverses and not tween.reversing then
			tween.reversing = true
		elseif tween.repeatsLeft ~= 0 then
			if tween.repeatsLeft > 0 then
				tween.repeatsLeft -= 1
			end
			tween.reversing = false
		else
			activeTweens[tween] = nil
			local value = tween.value
			for i, v in (if tween.reversing then tween.start else tween.target) do
				value[i] = v
			end
			return
		end
		tween.startTime += duration
		if duration <= 0 then
			alpha = 1
			break
		end
		alpha = (now - tween.startTime) / duration
	end

	alpha = tween.ease(math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1))
	if tween.reversing then
		alpha = 1 - alpha
	end
	local value, target = tween.value, tween.target
	for i, start in tween.start do
		value[i] = start + (target[i] - start) * alpha
	end
end

local stepping: { any } = {}

local function stepActive(activeMap: { [Motion]: any }, stepFn: (any, number) -> (), arg: number)
	if next(activeMap) == nil then
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for motion in activeMap do
		n += 1
		stepping[n] = motion
	end
	for i = 1, n do
		local motion = stepping[i]
		stepping[i] = nil
		local node = activeMap[motion]
		if node ~= nil then
			stepFn(motion, arg)
			setNode(node, motion.unpack(motion.value))
		end
	end
end

function Engine.step(dt: number?)
	local time = clock()
	local elapsed = math_max(0, dt or (time - lastClock))
	local now = Engine.now + elapsed
	lastClock = time
	Engine.now = now

	stepActive(activeSprings, stepSpring, elapsed)
	stepActive(activeTweens, stepTween, now)
end

-- Motion Nodes (spring & tween) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local tempArray = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
local NodeToMotion: { [Graph.Node<any>]: EngineSpring | Tween } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function packSpring(self: Graph.Node<any>, method: string, value: any): EngineSpring?
	local spring = NodeToMotion[self]
	if spring == nil or spring.type ~= TYPE_SPRING then
		warn(`[Flux] :{method}() is only valid on a spring; ignoring`)
		return nil
	end
	local val = raw(value)
	local typeString = typeof(val)
	if typeString ~= spring.typeString then
		local msg = if method == "impulse"
			then `Cannot impulse a {spring.typeString} spring with a {typeString} value`
			elseif
				method == "setVelocity"
			then `Cannot set velocity of a {spring.typeString} spring to a {typeString} value`
			elseif
				method == "setCurrent"
			then `Cannot set a {spring.typeString} spring's current value to a {typeString} value`
			else `Cannot snap a {spring.typeString} spring to a {typeString} value`
		error(msg, 3)
	end
	pack(tempArray, val, typeString)
	return spring :: EngineSpring
end

--- @class Spring
local MotionStateMetatable: { [string]: any } = {
	__call = function<T>(self: any, value: any?): any?
		if value ~= nil then
			self:set(value)
			return
		end
		return getSignal(self)
	end,
}
for key, method in SignalMT do
	if MotionStateMetatable[key] == nil then
		MotionStateMetatable[key] = method
	end
end
MotionStateMetatable.__index = MotionStateMetatable

--[[
Retargets the animation toward `value` from its current position (`motion(value)` does the same). If `value` is a node,
it's read once.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring#reactive-targets)
]]
function MotionStateMetatable.set<T>(self: Graph.Node<T>, value: T)
	local motion = NodeToMotion[self]
	if motion == nil then
		warn("[Flux] :set() called on a destroyed motion node; ignoring")
		return
	end
	local goal = raw(value)
	local typeString = typeof(goal)
	if typeString ~= motion.typeString then
		error(`Cannot retarget a {motion.typeString} motion with a {typeString} value`, 2)
	end
	Engine.setTarget(motion, pack(tempArray, goal, typeString))
end

--[[
*(Spring only)* Adds `delta` to the spring's current velocity without changing its goal.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring#velocity-control-impulse-set-velocity)
]]
function MotionStateMetatable.impulse<T>(self: Graph.Node<T>, delta: T)
	local spring = packSpring(self, "impulse", delta)
	if spring ~= nil then
		Engine.addVelocity(spring, tempArray)
	end
end

--[[
*(Spring only)* Replaces the spring's current velocity with `velocity` without changing its goal.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring#velocity-control-impulse-set-velocity)
]]
function MotionStateMetatable.setVelocity<T>(self: Graph.Node<T>, velocity: T)
	local spring = packSpring(self, "setVelocity", velocity)
	if spring ~= nil then
		Engine.setVelocity(spring, tempArray)
	end
end

--[[
*(Spring only)* Sets the spring's current animated value immediately without changing its target or velocity.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring)
]]
function MotionStateMetatable.setCurrent<T>(self: Graph.Node<T>, value: T)
	local spring = packSpring(self, "setCurrent", value)
	if spring == nil then
		return
	end
	local val = spring.value
	table.move(tempArray, 1, math.min(#tempArray, spring.count), 1, val)
	setNode(spring.node, spring.unpack(val))
	activeSprings[spring] = spring.node
end

--[[
*(Spring only)* Jumps both the target and current value of the spring to `value` and zeroes its velocity.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring#snap)
]]
function MotionStateMetatable.snap<T>(self: Graph.Node<T>, value: T)
	local spring = packSpring(self, "snap", value)
	if spring ~= nil then
		Engine.snap(spring, tempArray)
		setNode(spring.node, spring.unpack(spring.value))
	end
end

local function attachEffect(stateNode: Graph.Node<any>, fn: () -> ())
	local effectNode = effect(fn)
	stateNode:onDestroy(function()
		effectNode:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function register(stateNode: Graph.Node<any>, motion: EngineSpring | Tween)
	NodeToMotion[stateNode] = motion
	local function unregister()
		NodeToMotion[stateNode] = nil
		Engine.destroy(motion)
	end
	stateNode:onDestroy(unregister)
	if Graph.getOwner() then
		Graph.cleanup(unregister)
	end
end

local function packOrFallback(target: any, initialVal: any, typeStr: string): any
	pack(tempArray, initialVal, typeStr)
	if #tempArray ~= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if typeStr == "nil" then
		warn("[Flux] Animating a nil value; following the goal without animation")
		local stateNode: any = Graph.signal(initialVal)
		stateNode.snap = setNode
		stateNode.setCurrent = setNode
		stateNode.impulse = MotionStateMetatable.impulse
		stateNode.setVelocity = MotionStateMetatable.setVelocity
		if isDynamic(target) then
			attachEffect(stateNode, function()
				stateNode:set(read(target))
			end)
		end
		return stateNode
	end
	error(`Cannot animate a {typeStr} value`, 3)
end

local MotionModule = {
	Color = Color,
	--- @ignore
	Easing = Easing,
	--- @ignore
	Engine = Engine,
	--- @ignore
	NodeToMotion = NodeToMotion,
	--[[
	Advances every active [spring](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring) and
	[tween](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/tween) by `dt` seconds (or the time since the last step). Wired to
	`RunService` automatically in Roblox, so you only call this in tests (`Flux.Motion.step(1 / 60)`).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/tips/testing#full-engine-tests-in-ci)
	]]
	step = Engine.step,
}

--[[
Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that animates toward `target` using an analytic harmonic
oscillator (`frequency` in Hz and `damping` ratio both default to `1` and may be reactive). Retargets preserve current
velocity.

```luau
local size = Flux.spring(function() return if open() then 300 else 0 end, 4)
```

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring#basic-usage)
]]
function MotionModule.spring<A>(
	target: A,
	frequency: Reactive<number>?,
	damping: Reactive<number>?,
	initialVelocity: any?
): Spring<Unwrap<A>>
	local initialVal = raw(target)
	local typeStr = typeof(initialVal)
	local fallback = packOrFallback(target, initialVal, typeStr)
	if fallback ~= nil then
		return fallback
	end

	local stateNode = Graph.signal(initialVal)
	local spring = Engine.newSpring(#tempArray, typeStr, stateNode, raw(frequency), raw(damping))
	register(stateNode, spring)
	Engine.snap(spring, tempArray)
	if initialVelocity ~= nil then
		local initVel: any = raw(initialVelocity)
		if typeof(initVel) == typeStr then
			Engine.setVelocity(spring, pack(tempArray, initVel, typeStr))
		end
	end

	local dynamicTarget = isDynamic(target)
	local reactiveSetup = isDynamic(frequency) or isDynamic(damping)
	if dynamicTarget or reactiveSetup then
		attachEffect(stateNode, function()
			if reactiveSetup then
				local wasActive = activeSprings[spring] ~= nil
				Engine.setupSpring(spring, read(frequency), read(damping))
				if not wasActive then
					activeSprings[spring] = nil
				end
			end
			if dynamicTarget then
				local goal = read(target)
				if typeof(goal) == typeStr then
					Engine.setTarget(spring, pack(tempArray, goal, typeStr))
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local motionNode: any = setmetatable(stateNode, MotionStateMetatable)
	return motionNode
end

--[[
Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that eases toward `target` over a
[`TweenInfo`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/TweenInfo) curve. When `target` or `tweenInfo`
changes, the tween restarts from its current value without waiting for `DelayTime`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/tween#basic-usage)
]]
function MotionModule.tween<A>(target: A, tweenInfo: Reactive<TweenInfo>?): Graph.Node<Unwrap<A>>
	local initialVal = raw(target)
	local typeStr = typeof(initialVal)
	local fallback = packOrFallback(target, initialVal, typeStr)
	if fallback ~= nil then
		return fallback
	end

	local stateNode = Graph.signal(initialVal)
	local tween = Engine.newTween(#tempArray, typeStr, stateNode, raw(tweenInfo))
	register(stateNode, tween)
	Engine.snap(tween, tempArray)

	local dynamicTarget = isDynamic(target)
	local dynamicInfo = isDynamic(tweenInfo)
	if dynamicTarget or dynamicInfo then
		attachEffect(stateNode, function()
			if dynamicInfo then
				local i = read(tweenInfo) or Engine.DEFAULT_TWEEN_INFO
				if tween.info ~= i then
					local wasActive = activeTweens[tween] ~= nil
					Engine.setupTween(tween, i)
					if wasActive then
						tween.startTime = Engine.now
					else
						activeTweens[tween] = nil
					end
				end
			end
			if dynamicTarget then
				local goal = read(target)
				if typeof(goal) == typeStr then
					Engine.setTarget(tween, pack(tempArray, goal, typeStr))
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local motionNode: any = setmetatable(stateNode, MotionStateMetatable)
	return motionNode
end

return table.freeze(MotionModule)

--!strict
--[[
The screen and the player as shared nodes: viewport, UI scale, breakpoint, input device and accessibility settings.
Available as `Flux.Responsive`. For safe areas (the topbar, notches, rounded corners), set the engine's
`ScreenGui.ScreenInsets` (`CoreUISafeInsets` or `DeviceSafeInsets`) and `ScreenGui.SafeAreaCompatibility` instead.

```luau
Flux.new "UIScale" { Scale = Flux.Responsive.scale }
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local getService = Compat.getService
local warn = Compat.warn

local computed = Graph.computed
local read = Graph.read
local signal = Graph.signal

export type ScaleMode = "min" | "width" | "height" | "max"
export type Breakpoint = "phone" | "tablet" | "desktop"
export type Platform = "console" | "mobile" | "pc" | "vr"
export type DisplaySize = "Small" | "Medium" | "Large"
export type Input = "keyboard" | "touch" | "gamepad"
export type TextSize = "Medium" | "Large" | "Larger" | "Largest"
export type Breakpoints = { phone: number, tablet: number }

export type Config = {
	reference: Vector2,
	mode: ScaleMode,
	min: number?,
	max: number?,
	breakpoints: Breakpoints,
}

export type PartialConfig = {
	reference: Vector2?,
	mode: ScaleMode?,
	min: number?,
	max: number?,
	breakpoints: Breakpoints?,
	viewport: Graph.Reactive<Vector2>?,
}

local DEFAULT_SIZE = Compat.Vector2.new(1920, 1080)

--[[
Default responsive configuration shared by derived nodes. Mutate once at startup before building UI.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#configuration)
]]
local config: Config = {
	reference = DEFAULT_SIZE,
	mode = "min",
	breakpoints = { phone = 600, tablet = 1024 },
}

local EMPTY: PartialConfig = {}
local warnedModes: { [string]: boolean } = {}

local function scaleFor(width: number, height: number, partial: PartialConfig): number
	local ref = partial.reference or config.reference
	local refX, refY = math.max(ref.X, 1), math.max(ref.Y, 1)
	local mode = partial.mode or config.mode

	local factor: number
	if mode == "width" then
		factor = width / refX
	elseif mode == "height" then
		factor = height / refY
	elseif mode == "max" then
		factor = math.max(width / refX, height / refY)
	else
		if mode ~= "min" then
			local key = tostring(mode)
			if not warnedModes[key] then
				warnedModes[key] = true
				warn(`[Flux] unknown scale mode "{mode}"; falling back to "min"`)
			end
		end
		factor = math.min(width / refX, height / refY)
	end

	local min = if partial.min ~= nil then partial.min else config.min
	if min ~= nil and factor < min then
		factor = min
	end
	local max = if partial.max ~= nil then partial.max else config.max
	if max ~= nil and factor > max then
		factor = max
	end

	return factor
end

local function breakpointFor(width: number, partial: PartialConfig): Breakpoint
	local breakpoints = partial.breakpoints or config.breakpoints
	if width < breakpoints.phone then
		return "phone"
	elseif width < breakpoints.tablet then
		return "tablet"
	end
	return "desktop"
end

--[[
The active camera's `ViewportSize` as a node, live on the client.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#viewport)
]]
local viewport: Graph.Node<Vector2> = signal(DEFAULT_SIZE)

--[[
Factory escape hatch: a `scale` node with per-surface config (merged over defaults).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#per-surface-overrides)
]]
local function scaleOf(partial: PartialConfig?): Graph.Node<number>
	local cfg = partial or EMPTY
	local source = cfg.viewport or viewport
	return computed(function(): number
		local vp = read(source) :: Vector2
		return scaleFor(vp.X, vp.Y, cfg)
	end)
end

--[[
Factory escape hatch: a `breakpoint` node with per-surface thresholds.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#per-surface-overrides)
]]
local function breakpointOf(partial: PartialConfig?): Graph.Node<Breakpoint>
	local cfg = partial or EMPTY
	local source = cfg.viewport or viewport
	return computed(function(): Breakpoint
		local vp = read(source) :: Vector2
		return breakpointFor(vp.X, cfg)
	end)
end

--[[
UI scale factor derived from `viewport` (`1.0` at `config.reference`).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#scale)
]]
local scale: Graph.Node<number> = scaleOf()
--[[
Size class (`"phone" | "tablet" | "desktop"`) derived from `viewport` width.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#breakpoint)
]]
local breakpoint: Graph.Node<Breakpoint> = breakpointOf()

local RunService = getService("RunService")
local isClient = RunService ~= nil and RunService:IsClient() and RunService:IsRunning()
local GuiService = isClient and getService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = isClient and getService("UserInputService")
local VRService = isClient and getService("VRService")
local tenFoot = isClient and GuiService:IsTenFootInterface()

local function detectPlatform(): Platform
	return if VRService.VREnabled
		then "vr"
		elseif tenFoot then "console"
		elseif UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and UserInputService.MouseEnabled then "pc"
		else "mobile"
end

--[[
Active device class (`"vr"`, `"console"`, `"pc"`, or `"mobile"`), updated live on the client (`"pc"` off-client).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#platform)
]]
local platform: Graph.Node<Platform> = signal((if isClient then detectPlatform() else "pc") :: Platform)
--[[
Physical screen size class (`"Small"`, `"Medium"`, or `"Large"`) mirroring `GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#display-size)
]]
local displaySize: Graph.Node<DisplaySize> = signal((if tenFoot then "Large" else "Medium") :: DisplaySize)

local INPUT_BY_NAME: { [string]: Input } = {
	KeyboardAndMouse = "keyboard",
	Keyboard = "keyboard",
	MouseMovement = "keyboard",
	MouseButton1 = "keyboard",
	MouseButton2 = "keyboard",
	MouseButton3 = "keyboard",
	MouseWheel = "keyboard",
	Touch = "touch",
	Gamepad = "gamepad",
}
for slot = 1, 8 do
	INPUT_BY_NAME[`Gamepad{slot}`] = "gamepad"
end

local function inputFor(name: string): Input?
	return INPUT_BY_NAME[name]
end

local INPUT_BY_PLATFORM: { [Platform]: Input } = {
	pc = "keyboard",
	mobile = "touch",
	console = "gamepad",
	vr = "gamepad",
}

--[[
Active input mode (`"keyboard"`, `"touch"`, or `"gamepad"`) tracking `UserInputService.PreferredInput` on the client.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#input)
]]
local input: Graph.Node<Input> = signal(INPUT_BY_PLATFORM[platform:peek()] :: Input)
--[[
Player's preferred text size (`"Medium"`, `"Large"`, `"Larger"`, or `"Largest"`) from `GuiService.PreferredTextSize`.
Roblox scales rendered text automatically, so use this to adjust surrounding container spacing rather than multiplying `TextSize`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#text-size)
]]
local textSize: Graph.Node<TextSize> = signal("Medium" :: TextSize)
--[[
Tracks `GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled` (`true` when the player prefers reduced motion).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#reduced-motion)
]]
local reducedMotion: Graph.Node<boolean> = signal(false)
--[[
Tracks `GuiService.PreferredTransparency` from `0` (opaque backgrounds) to `1` (default).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive#preferred-transparency)
]]
local preferredTransparency: Graph.Node<number> = signal(1)

if isClient then
	local Workspace = getService("Workspace")

	local viewportConnection: RBXScriptConnection?
	local function bindCamera(camera: Camera?)
		if viewportConnection ~= nil then
			viewportConnection:Disconnect()
			viewportConnection = nil
		end
		if camera ~= nil then
			viewport:set(camera.ViewportSize)
			viewportConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
				viewport:set(camera.ViewportSize)
			end)
		end
	end

	local serviceConnections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	bindCamera(Workspace.CurrentCamera)
	local cameraConn: RBXScriptConnection = Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		bindCamera(Workspace.CurrentCamera)
	end)
	table.insert(serviceConnections, cameraConn)
	local function mirror(
		object: Instance,
		property: string,
		node: Graph.Node<any>,
		map: ((value: any) -> any)?
	): boolean
		local ok, changed = pcall(object.GetPropertyChangedSignal, object, property)
		if not ok then
			return false
		end
		local rawObject: any = object
		local function sync()
			local rawValue = rawObject[property]
			local value = if map then map(rawValue) else rawValue
			if value ~= nil then
				node:set(value)
			end
		end
		sync()
		local conn: RBXScriptConnection = changed:Connect(sync)
		table.insert(serviceConnections, conn)
		return true
	end

	local function nameOf(item: EnumItem): string
		return item.Name
	end
	local function inputOf(item: EnumItem): Input?
		local name = item.Name
		return inputFor(name)
	end
	local function syncPlatform()
		platform:set(detectPlatform())
	end
	local function bindPlatform(object: Instance, property: string)
		local ok, changed = pcall(object.GetPropertyChangedSignal, object, property)
		if ok then
			local conn: RBXScriptConnection = changed:Connect(syncPlatform)
			table.insert(serviceConnections, conn)
		end
	end

	if not mirror(UserInputService, "PreferredInput", input, inputOf) then
		local conn: RBXScriptConnection = UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(
			function(lastInputType: Enum.UserInputType)
				local mode = inputFor(lastInputType.Name)
				if mode ~= nil then
					input:set(mode)
				end
			end
		)
		table.insert(serviceConnections, conn)
	end
	mirror(GuiService, "PreferredTextSize", textSize, nameOf)
	mirror(GuiService, "ViewportDisplaySize", displaySize, nameOf)
	bindPlatform(UserInputService, "KeyboardEnabled")
	bindPlatform(UserInputService, "MouseEnabled")
	bindPlatform(VRService, "VREnabled")
	mirror(GuiService, "ReducedMotionEnabled", reducedMotion)
	mirror(GuiService, "PreferredTransparency", preferredTransparency)
end

return table.freeze({
	config = config,
	platform = platform,

	viewport = viewport,
	scale = scale,
	breakpoint = breakpoint,
	displaySize = displaySize,

	input = input,
	textSize = textSize,
	reducedMotion = reducedMotion,
	preferredTransparency = preferredTransparency,

	scaleOf = scaleOf,
	breakpointOf = breakpointOf,

	--- @ignore
	_inputFor = inputFor,
})

--!strict
--[[
Deep reactive stores: `Flux.store(table)` returns a proxy whose fields are tracked per key, with `Flux.Store` helpers
for arrays, snapshots and teardown.

```luau
local state = Flux.store({ player = { hp = 100 } })
Flux.effect(function() print(state.player.hp) end)
state.player.hp = 90
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local cleanup = Graph.cleanup
local newValue = Graph.signal
local get = Graph.Node.get
local setValue = Graph.Node.set
local destroyNode = Graph.Node.Destroy
local isReactive = Graph.isReactive
local isObserved = Graph.isObserved
local getOwner = Graph.getOwner
local register = Graph.register
local warn = Compat.warn

--- @ignore
type Meta = {
	__index: (proxy: any, key: any) -> any,
	__newindex: (proxy: any, key: any, value: any) -> (),
	__iter: (proxy: any) -> ...any,
	__len: (proxy: any) -> number,
	target: { [any]: any },
	nodes: { [any]: Graph.Node<any> },
	parent: Meta?,
	children: { [any]: boolean }?,
}

local proxyCache: { [any]: any } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "v" })
local proxyToRaw: { [any]: { [any]: any } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local STORE_SYMBOL: any = table.freeze({})

local function toRaw(value: any): any
	return if type(value) == "table" then proxyToRaw[value] or value else value
end

local index: (proxy: any, key: any) -> any
local newindex: (proxy: any, key: any, value: any) -> ()
local iter: (proxy: any) -> ...any
local len: (proxy: any) -> number

local function destroyProxy(proxy: any)
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if target == nil then
		return
	end
	local meta = getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta
	if proxyCache[target] == proxy then
		proxyCache[target] = nil
	end
	proxyToRaw[proxy] = nil
	register(proxy, nil)
	setmetatable(proxy, nil)

	local parent = meta.parent
	if parent and parent.children then
		parent.children[proxy] = nil
	end
	local children = meta.children
	if children then
		meta.children = nil
		for child in children do
			destroyProxy(child)
		end
	end
	local nodes = meta.nodes
	for _, node in nodes do
		destroyNode(node)
	end
	table.clear(nodes)
end

local function createProxy<T>(target: T, parentMeta: Meta?): T
	local rawTarget: any = target
	local cached = proxyCache[rawTarget]
	if cached then
		return cached
	end

	local nodes: { [any]: Graph.Node<any> } = {}
	local meta: Meta = {
		__index = index,
		__newindex = newindex,
		__iter = iter,
		__len = len,
		target = rawTarget,
		nodes = nodes,
		parent = parentMeta,
		children = nil,
	}
	local proxy: any = setmetatable({}, meta)

	proxyCache[rawTarget] = proxy
	proxyToRaw[proxy] = rawTarget
	register(proxy, destroyProxy)

	if parentMeta then
		local children = parentMeta.children
		if children == nil then
			children = {}
			parentMeta.children = children
		end
		(children :: { [any]: boolean })[proxy] = true
	elseif getOwner() ~= nil then
		cleanup(proxy)
	end

	return proxy
end

local function teardownDisplaced(target: { [any]: any }, displaced: any)
	if type(displaced) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local displacedProxy = proxyCache[displaced]
	if displacedProxy == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, value in target do
		if value == displaced then
			return
		end
	end
	destroyProxy(displacedProxy)
end

local function fireTracker(nodes: { [any]: any }, target: { [any]: any })
	local tracker = nodes[STORE_SYMBOL]
	if tracker then
		setValue(tracker, target, true)
	end
end

local function resyncIndices(nodes: { [any]: any }, target: { [any]: any }, from: number, to: number)
	for i = from, to do
		local node = nodes[i]
		if node then
			setValue(node, target[i])
		end
	end
end

local function readTracker(meta: Meta): { [any]: any }
	local target = meta.target
	local nodes = meta.nodes

	local tracker = nodes[STORE_SYMBOL]
	if not tracker then
		tracker = newValue(target)
		nodes[STORE_SYMBOL] = tracker
	end
	get(tracker)

	return target
end

local function validatePos(pos: any, max: number): number
	if type(pos) ~= "number" then
		error(`Position must be a number, got {typeof(pos)}`, 3)
	elseif pos ~= math.floor(pos) or pos < 1 or pos > max then
		error(`Position {pos} out of range [1, {max}]`, 3)
	end
	return pos
end

function index(proxy: any, key: any): any
	local meta: Meta = getmetatable(proxy)
	local value = rawget(meta.target, key)

	if isReactive() then
		local nodes = meta.nodes
		local node = nodes[key]
		if node == nil then
			node = newValue(value)
			nodes[key] = node
		end
		get(node)
	end

	if type(value) == "table" and getmetatable(value) == nil then
		return createProxy(value, meta)
	end
	return value
end

function newindex(proxy: any, key: any, newVal: any)
	local meta: Meta = getmetatable(proxy)
	local target = meta.target
	local rawValue = toRaw(newVal)
	local oldValue = rawget(target, key)
	if oldValue == rawValue and type(rawValue) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	rawset(target, key, rawValue)
	if type(oldValue) == "table" and oldValue ~= rawValue then
		teardownDisplaced(target, oldValue)
	end

	local nodes = meta.nodes
	local node = nodes[key]
	if node ~= nil then
		setValue(node, rawValue)
		if rawValue == nil and not isReactive() and getOwner() == nil and not isObserved(node) then
			nodes[key] = nil
			destroyNode(node)
		end
	end

	fireTracker(nodes, target)
end

local function nextProxy(meta: Meta, k: any): (any, any)
	local key, value = next(meta.target, k)
	if type(value) == "table" and getmetatable(value) == nil then
		return key, createProxy(value, meta)
	end
	return key, value
end

function iter(proxy: any)
	local meta: Meta = getmetatable(proxy)
	readTracker(meta)
	return nextProxy, meta
end

function len(proxy: any): number
	return #readTracker(getmetatable(proxy))
end

local Store = {}

--[[
Wraps a plain table in a deep reactive proxy that tracks each read key, nested table, and array length independently.
Values that already have a metatable (such as Flux nodes or class instances) are left untouched.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#creating-a-store)
]]
function Store.new<T>(initialState: T): T
	local state: any = initialState
	assert(type(state) == "table", "Store initialState must be a table")
	if proxyToRaw[state] ~= nil then
		return state
	end
	return createProxy(state)
end

--[[
Tears down a store and all of its nested proxies, disposing their per-key nodes via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/api/Flux#dispose) while leaving the raw backing table intact.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#destroying-a-store)
]]
function Store.Destroy<T>(proxy: T)
	destroyProxy(proxy)
end

--[[
Returns the raw, unproxied backing table of a store for untracked reads or serialization.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#unwrapping-a-store)
]]
function Store.unwrap<T>(proxy: T): T
	return (proxyToRaw[proxy] or proxy) :: T
end

--[[
Inserts `value` into a store array (appending with 2 arguments, or inserting at `posOrValue` with 3) and notifies length and index observers.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#arrays-and-iteration)
]]
function Store.insert(proxy: any, posOrValue: any, value: any?)
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if not target then
		if value == nil then
			table.insert(proxy, posOrValue)
		else
			table.insert(proxy, posOrValue, value)
		end
		return
	end

	local pos: number
	local val: any
	if value == nil then
		pos = #target + 1
		val = posOrValue
	else
		pos = validatePos(posOrValue, #target + 1)
		val = value
	end

	local rawValue = toRaw(val)
	table.insert(target, pos, rawValue)

	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	resyncIndices(nodes, target, pos, #target)
	fireTracker(nodes, target)
end

--[[
Removes and returns the element at `pos` (defaulting to the last element) from a store array and notifies length and index observers.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#arrays-and-iteration)
]]
function Store.remove(proxy: any, pos: number?): any
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if not target then
		return table.remove(proxy, pos)
	end

	local length = #target
	if pos ~= nil then
		validatePos(pos, length)
	end
	if length == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local idx = pos or length
	local removed = table.remove(target, idx)

	teardownDisplaced(target, removed)

	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	resyncIndices(nodes, target, idx, length - 1)
	local tailNode = nodes[length]
	if tailNode then
		setValue(tailNode, nil)
	end

	fireTracker(nodes, target)
	return removed
end

--[[
Moves the element at 1-based index `from` to `to` in a single tracked step without tearing down nested item proxies.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#arrays-and-iteration)
]]
function Store.move(proxy: any, from: number, to: number)
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	if not target then
		table.insert(proxy, to, table.remove(proxy, from))
		return
	end

	local length = #target
	validatePos(from, length)
	validatePos(to, length)
	if from == to then
		return
	end

	table.insert(target, to, table.remove(target, from))

	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	resyncIndices(nodes, target, math.min(from, to), math.max(from, to))
	fireTracker(nodes, target)
end

local function isArrayLike(t: { [any]: any }): boolean
	return rawget(t, 1) ~= nil
end

local function isArrayIndex(key: any, arrayLen: number): boolean
	return type(key) == "number" and key >= 1 and key <= arrayLen and key == math.floor(key)
end

local reconcileTable: (proxy: any, target: { [any]: any }, newData: { [any]: any }, reconcileKey: string?) -> ()

local function syncRaw(old: { [any]: any }, newData: { [any]: any })
	for field in old do
		if rawget(newData, field) == nil then
			old[field] = nil
		end
	end
	for field, value in newData do
		old[field] = toRaw(value)
	end
end

local function reconcileLeaf(
	target: { [any]: any },
	nodes: { [any]: any },
	key: any,
	rawNew: any,
	reconcileKey: string?
): boolean
	local oldValue = rawget(target, key)
	if oldValue == rawNew then
		return false
	end
	if type(oldValue) == "table" and type(rawNew) == "table" then
		local oldProxy = proxyCache[oldValue]
		if oldProxy ~= nil then
			reconcileTable(oldProxy, oldValue, rawNew, reconcileKey)
		else
			syncRaw(oldValue, rawNew)
		end
		return false
	end
	rawset(target, key, rawNew)
	if type(oldValue) == "table" then
		teardownDisplaced(target, oldValue)
	end
	local node = nodes[key]
	if node ~= nil then
		setValue(node, rawNew)
	end
	return true
end

local function reconcileArray(target: { [any]: any }, newData: { [any]: any }, nodes: { [any]: any }): (number, boolean)
	local oldLen = #target
	local newLen = #newData
	local span = if oldLen > newLen then oldLen else newLen
	local structural = false

	for i = 1, span do
		structural = reconcileLeaf(target, nodes, i, toRaw(rawget(newData, i)), nil) or structural
	end

	return span, structural
end

local function reconcileArrayKeyed(
	target: { [any]: any },
	newData: { [any]: any },
	nodes: { [any]: any },
	reconcileKey: string
): (number, boolean)
	local oldLen = #target
	local newLen = #newData
	local span = if oldLen > newLen then oldLen else newLen
	local structural = false

	local oldElems = table.create(span)
	local oldByKey: { [any]: any } = {}
	for i = 1, span do
		local el = rawget(target, i)
		if el == nil then
			continue
		end
		oldElems[i] = el
		if type(el) == "table" then
			local k = rawget(el, reconcileKey)
			if k ~= nil then
				oldByKey[k] = el
			end
		end
	end

	local matched: { [any]: boolean } = {}
	local seenKeys: { [any]: boolean } = {}
	for i = 1, span do
		local rawNew = toRaw(rawget(newData, i))

		local placed = rawNew
		if type(rawNew) == "table" then
			local k = rawget(rawNew, reconcileKey)
			local reuse
			if k ~= nil then
				if seenKeys[k] then
					warn(
						`[Flux] Store.reconcile: duplicate key "{tostring(k)}" on field "{reconcileKey}"; keys must be unique or the duplicate aliases one element`
					)
				else
					seenKeys[k] = true
				end
				reuse = oldByKey[k]
			else
				local old: any = oldElems[i]
				if type(old) == "table" and rawget(old, reconcileKey) == nil then
					reuse = old
				end
			end
			if reuse ~= nil then
				matched[reuse] = true
				local childProxy = proxyCache[reuse]
				if childProxy ~= nil then
					reconcileTable(childProxy, reuse, rawNew, reconcileKey)
				else
					syncRaw(reuse, rawNew)
				end
				placed = reuse
			end
		end

		if rawget(target, i) ~= placed then
			structural = true
			rawset(target, i, placed)
			local node = nodes[i]
			if node ~= nil then
				setValue(node, placed)
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, span do
		local el = oldElems[i]
		if type(el) == "table" and not matched[el] then
			teardownDisplaced(target, el)
		end
	end

	return span, structural
end

function reconcileTable(proxy: any, target: { [any]: any }, newData: { [any]: any }, reconcileKey: string?)
	local nodes = (getmetatable(proxy) :: Meta).nodes
	local structural = false

	local arrayLen = 0
	if isArrayLike(target) or isArrayLike(newData) then
		if reconcileKey ~= nil then
			arrayLen, structural = reconcileArrayKeyed(target, newData, nodes, reconcileKey)
		else
			arrayLen, structural = reconcileArray(target, newData, nodes)
		end
	end

	for key, newVal in newData do
		if isArrayIndex(key, arrayLen) then
			continue
		end
		structural = reconcileLeaf(target, nodes, key, toRaw(newVal), reconcileKey) or structural
	end

	for key in target do
		if isArrayIndex(key, arrayLen) then
			continue
		end
		if rawget(newData, key) == nil then
			structural = true
			reconcileLeaf(target, nodes, key, nil, reconcileKey)
		end
	end

	if structural then
		fireTracker(nodes, target)
	end
end

--[[
Diffs `newData` into the store `proxy` in place, firing only changed leaf nodes and reusing unchanged nested proxies.
Pass `key` to match array elements by `element[key]` instead of array index.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/stores#reconciling-snapshots)
]]
function Store.reconcile<T>(proxy: T, newData: T, key: string?): T
	local target = proxyToRaw[proxy]
	assert(target ~= nil, "Store.reconcile expects a store proxy")
	assert(type(newData) == "table", "Store.reconcile newData must be a table")

	local rawNew: { [any]: any } = toRaw(newData)
	reconcileTable(proxy, target, rawNew, key)
	return proxy
end

return table.freeze(Store)

--!strict
--[[
Network-synchronized signals shared between the server and clients.
Writes batch once per frame over a single `RemoteEvent` (or `UnreliableRemoteEvent`), and clients sync automatically on join.

```luau
-- Shared
local round = Flux.Sync("Round", "Lobby")
local coins = Flux.Sync("Coins", 0)
local theme = Flux.Sync("Theme", "Dark", function(player, value)
	return value == "Dark" or value == "Light" -- clients may write it; the server validates
end)

-- Server
round("Fighting") -- every client
coins:of(player)(250) -- only that player

-- Client
Flux.new "TextLabel" { Text = function() return `{round()}: {coins()} coins` end }
theme("Light") -- optimistic; rolled back if the server rejects it
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local Instance = Compat.Instance
local warn = Compat.warn
local Players: Players? = Compat.getService("Players")
local RunService: RunService? = Compat.getService("RunService")

local sampleSignal: any = Graph.signal(nil)
local SignalMT: any = getmetatable(sampleSignal)
local rawGet = SignalMT.get
local rawSet = SignalMT.set
local rawDestroy = SignalMT.Destroy

local function newSignal(initial: any, mt: any): any
	local raw: any = Graph.signal(initial)
	return setmetatable(raw, mt)
end

--[[
Validates a client write on the server (`fn(player, value)`).
Return `true` to accept (`true, replacement` to store `replacement`), or `false`/`nil` to reject without yielding.
]]
export type Validator<T> = (player: Player, value: T) -> (boolean?, ...T)

--[[
A signal synchronized between the server and clients.
Server writes replicate to all clients, and client writes are validated on the server.
]]
export type SyncSignal<T = any> = Graph.State<T> & {
	--[[
	Returns a per-player signal on the server whose writes replicate only to `player` (returns `self` on the client).
	]]
	of: (self: any, player: Player) -> Graph.State<T>,
	--[[
	Clears `player`'s per-player override on the server so they see the shared value again.
	]]
	clear: (self: any, player: Player) -> (),
	--[[
	Sets the server-side validator that allows clients to write to this signal (`nil` makes it server-only).
	]]
	validate: (self: any, fn: Validator<T>?) -> SyncSignal<T>,
	--[[
	Configures this signal to replicate over an `UnreliableRemoteEvent` instead of a reliable `RemoteEvent`.
	]]
	unreliable: (self: any, enabled: boolean?) -> SyncSignal<T>,
}

-- A table & function intersection rather than a `__call` metatable type: the solver only instantiates `T` through a
-- plain function type.
export type Namespace = {
	--[[
	Sends all pending synced changes immediately instead of waiting for the end of the frame.
	]]
	flush: () -> (),
	--[[
	Read-only node that is `true` on the server and turns `true` on the client once the initial sync arrives.
	]]
	ready: Graph.Node<boolean>,
	[string]: SyncSignal<any>,
} & (<T>(key: string, initial: T, validate: Validator<T>?) -> SyncSignal<T>)

-- Each synced signal stores its graph node at `[1]` alongside Sync's `_` bookkeeping fields.
type Synced = {
	_sync: Sync,
	_key: string,
	_id: string?,
	_validator: Validator<any>?,
	_unreliable: boolean,
	-- written (or given an initial) since creation, so a later `Flux.Sync(key, initial)` must not overwrite it
	_touched: boolean,
	-- server: per-player signals, created by the first `:of` (which routes accepted client writes per player)
	_own: { [any]: PlayerSignal }?,
	_ownCount: number,
	_yieldWarned: boolean?,
	-- client: the stamp of the last batch that carried this signal
	_lastSent: number,
}

type PlayerSignal = {
	_owner: Synced?,
	_player: any,
}

-- One side of the protocol. `reliable`/`unreliable` are the remotes, or tables with the same Fire methods in tests.
type Sync = {
	isServer: boolean,
	reliable: any,
	unreliable: any,
	signals: { [string]: Synced },
	byId: { [string]: Synced },
	ready: Graph.State<boolean>,
	connections: { RBXScriptConnection },
	-- server
	count: number,
	-- joined players -> client batches received (the ack they get back)
	received: { [any]: number },
	-- players who left; weak keys
	gone: { [any]: true },
	ackDirty: { [any]: boolean },
	playerDirty: { [any]: { [Synced]: boolean } },
	globalDirty: { [Synced]: boolean },
	announce: { Synced },
	validating: Synced?,
	wrote: boolean,
	-- client
	joined: boolean,
	sent: number,
	acked: number,
	outDirty: { [Synced]: boolean },
}

local instances: { [Sync]: true } = {}
local default: Sync? = nil

-- Batch buffers reused by every flush (flushes never nest: remotes serialize their arguments on the spot).
local reliableBuf: { any } = {}
local unreliableBuf: { any } = {}
local scopedBuf: { Synced } = {}

local function push(list: { any }, n: number, id: any, value: any): number
	list[n + 1] = id
	list[n + 2] = value
	return n + 2
end

local function pushEntry(
	reliableList: { any },
	rn: number,
	unreliableList: { any },
	un: number,
	entry: Synced,
	value: any
): (number, number)
	if entry._unreliable then
		return rn, push(unreliableList, un, entry._id, value)
	end
	return push(reliableList, rn, entry._id, value), un
end

local function idOf(n: number): string
	if n < 256 then
		return string.char(n)
	elseif n < 65536 then
		return string.pack("<I2", n)
	end
	error("Flux.Sync: more than 65536 synced signals", 5)
end

local function nodeValue(signal: any): any
	return signal[1][1]
end

local function valueFor(entry: Synced, player: any): any
	local own = entry._own
	local mine = own and own[player]
	return nodeValue(mine or entry)
end

local function markPlayer(sync: Sync, entry: Synced, player: any)
	local dirty = sync.playerDirty[player]
	if dirty == nil then
		dirty = {}
		sync.playerDirty[player] = dirty
	end
	dirty[entry] = true
end

local function written(sync: Sync, entry: Synced, player: any?)
	if not sync.isServer then
		sync.outDirty[entry] = true
		return
	end
	if sync.validating == entry then
		sync.wrote = true
	end
	if player == nil then
		sync.globalDirty[entry] = true
	else
		markPlayer(sync, entry, player)
	end
end

-- Drops `player`'s own signal; true if there was one.
local function drop(entry: Synced, player: any): boolean
	local own = entry._own
	local mine = if own then own[player] else nil
	if own == nil or mine == nil then
		return false
	end
	own[player] = nil
	entry._ownCount -= 1
	mine._owner = nil
	rawDestroy(mine)
	return true
end

local function call(self: any, value: any?, force: boolean?): any
	if value == nil and not force then
		return rawGet(self)
	end
	return self:set(value, force)
end

-- Forces a write of the current value so in-place table mutations replicate.
local function update(self: any): any
	self:set(nodeValue(self), true)
	return self
end

local SyncMT: any = table.clone(SignalMT)
SyncMT.__index = SyncMT
SyncMT.__call = call
SyncMT.update = update

local PlayerMT: any = table.clone(SignalMT)
PlayerMT.__index = PlayerMT
PlayerMT.__call = call
PlayerMT.update = update

function SyncMT.set(self: Synced, value: any, force: boolean?): any
	local old = nodeValue(self)
	rawSet(self, value, force)
	if old ~= value or force then
		self._touched = true
		written(self._sync, self, nil)
	end
	return value
end

function PlayerMT.set(self: PlayerSignal, value: any, force: boolean?): any
	local old = nodeValue(self)
	rawSet(self, value, force)
	local owner = self._owner
	if owner and (old ~= value or force) then
		written(owner._sync, owner, self._player)
	end
	return value
end

function SyncMT.of(self: Synced, player: any): any
	local sync = self._sync
	if not sync.isServer then
		return self
	end
	local own = self._own
	local mine = if own then own[player] else nil
	if mine then
		return mine
	elseif sync.gone[player] then
		error(`Flux.Sync: {player} left; "{self._key}" has no value for them anymore`, 2)
	end
	local node: PlayerSignal = newSignal(nodeValue(self), PlayerMT)
	node._owner = self
	node._player = player
	if own then
		own[player] = node
	else
		self._own = { [player] = node }
	end
	self._ownCount += 1
	-- the player may not have been sent the shared value this node starts from yet
	markPlayer(sync, self, player)
	return node
end

function SyncMT.clear(self: Synced, player: any)
	if drop(self, player) then
		written(self._sync, self, player)
	end
end

function SyncMT.validate(self: Synced, fn: Validator<any>?): any
	self._validator = fn
	return self
end

function SyncMT.unreliable(self: Synced, enabled: boolean?): any
	self._unreliable = enabled ~= false
	return self
end

table.freeze(SyncMT)
table.freeze(PlayerMT)

local function createEntry(sync: Sync, key: string, initial: any): Synced
	local id = if sync.isServer then idOf(sync.count) else nil
	local entry: Synced = newSignal(initial, SyncMT)
	entry._sync = sync
	entry._key = key
	entry._id = id
	entry._unreliable = false
	entry._touched = initial ~= nil
	entry._ownCount = 0
	entry._lastSent = 0
	sync.signals[key] = entry
	if id then
		sync.count += 1
		sync.byId[id] = entry
		if next(sync.received) ~= nil then
			table.insert(sync.announce, entry)
		end
	end
	return entry
end

local function signal(sync: Sync, key: string, initial: any, validate: Validator<any>?): Synced
	if type(key) ~= "string" then
		error(`Flux.Sync: the key must be a string, got {typeof(key)}`, 3)
	end
	local entry = sync.signals[key]
	if entry == nil then
		entry = createEntry(sync, key, initial)
	elseif initial ~= nil and not entry._touched then
		entry._touched = true
		rawSet(entry, initial)
		if sync.isServer then
			sync.globalDirty[entry] = true
		end
	end
	if validate then
		entry._validator = validate
	end
	return entry
end

-- client: applies a server value unless the client has a write the server has not answered yet
local function applyRemote(sync: Sync, entry: Synced?, value: any)
	if entry == nil or sync.outDirty[entry] or entry._lastSent > sync.acked then
		return
	end
	entry._touched = true
	rawSet(entry, value)
end

local function link(sync: Sync, links: any, handshake: boolean)
	if type(links) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	for id, data in links do
		if type(id) ~= "string" or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data[1]) ~= "string" then
			continue
		end
		local key = data[1]
		local entry = sync.signals[key] or createEntry(sync, key, nil)
		entry._id = id
		sync.byId[id] = entry
		applyRemote(sync, entry, data[2])
	end
	if handshake and not sync.joined then
		sync.joined = true
		sync.ready:set(true)
	end
end

-- Runs `entry`'s validator on a coroutine so a yield is caught (and rejected) instead of leaking `validating` into
-- other remote threads. Returns whether to store a value and which one.
local function runValidator(
	sync: Sync,
	entry: Synced,
	validator: Validator<any>,
	player: any,
	value: any
): (boolean, any)
	local thread = coroutine.create(validator)
	sync.validating, sync.wrote = entry, false
	local ok, accepted, replacement = coroutine.resume(thread, player, value)
	sync.validating = nil
	if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" then
		coroutine.close(thread)
		if not entry._yieldWarned then
			entry._yieldWarned = true
			warn(
				`[Flux] Sync validator for "{entry._key}" yielded; validators must not yield, so the write is rejected`
			)
		end
		return false, nil
	elseif not ok then
		warn(`[Flux] Sync validator for "{entry._key}" errored: {accepted}`)
		return false, nil
	end
	if not accepted or sync.wrote then
		return false, nil
	end
	return true, if replacement ~= nil then replacement else value
end

local function applyServer(sync: Sync, entry: Synced, player: any, value: any)
	local validator = entry._validator
	if validator then
		local accept, stored = runValidator(sync, entry, validator, player, value)
		if accept then
			local target: any = if entry._own then SyncMT.of(entry, player) else entry
			target:set(stored)
		end
	end
	if valueFor(entry, player) ~= value then
		written(sync, entry, player)
	else
		-- the client already shows this value; skip echoing it back to them
		local dirty = sync.playerDirty[player]
		if dirty then
			dirty[entry] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function hello(sync: Sync, player: any)
	if sync.received[player] or sync.gone[player] then
		return
	end
	sync.received[player] = 0
	sync.playerDirty[player] = nil
	local links = {}
	for key, entry in sync.signals do
		links[entry._id :: string] = { key, valueFor(entry, player) }
	end
	sync.reliable:FireClient(player, links, true)
end

-- Server -> client messages: `(id, value, ...)` batches, `(ack, id, value, ...)` per-player batches (ack = client
-- batches processed), `(links)` new ids and `(links, true)` the join handshake, links being
-- `{ [id] = { key, value } }`. Client -> server: `()` hello and `(id, value, ...)` batches.
local function receive(sync: Sync, ...: any)
	local n = select("#", ...)
	if sync.isServer then
		local player = ...
		if n == 1 then
			hello(sync, player)
			return
		end
		local received = sync.received[player]
		if received == nil then
			return
		end
		sync.received[player] = received + 1
		sync.ackDirty[player] = true
		local args = { ... }
		local byId = sync.byId
		for i = 2, n, 2 do
			local id = args[i]
			local entry = if type(id) == "string" then byId[id] else nil
			if entry then
				applyServer(sync, entry, player, args[i + 1])
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if n == 0 then
		return
	end
	local first, second = ...
	if type(first) == "table" then
		link(sync, first, second == true)
		return
	end
	local start = 1
	if type(first) == "number" then
		sync.acked = math.max(sync.acked, first)
		start = 2
	end
	if n < start then
		return
	end
	local args = { ... }
	local byId = sync.byId
	for i = start, n, 2 do
		local id = args[i]
		applyRemote(sync, if type(id) == "string" then byId[id] else nil, args[i + 1])
	end
end

local function flushServer(sync: Sync)
	local reliable = sync.reliable
	local unreliable = sync.unreliable or reliable
	local received, globalDirty, playerDirty, ackDirty =
		sync.received, sync.globalDirty, sync.playerDirty, sync.ackDirty

	local announce = sync.announce
	if #announce > 0 then
		local links = {}
		for _, entry in announce do
			links[entry._id] = { entry._key, nodeValue(entry) }
			if entry._ownCount == 0 then
				globalDirty[entry] = nil
			end
		end
		table.clear(announce)
		reliable:FireAllClients(links)
	end

	-- shared values of signals with per-player overrides go out per player, skipping players with their own
	local sn = 0
	for entry in globalDirty do
		if entry._ownCount > 0 then
			sn += 1
			scopedBuf[sn] = entry
		end
	end

	local rn, un
	for player, ack in received do
		local dirty = playerDirty[player]
		local hasDirty = dirty ~= nil and next(dirty) ~= nil
		if not hasDirty and sn == 0 and not ackDirty[player] then
			continue
		end
		reliableBuf[1] = ack
		rn, un = 1, 0
		if dirty ~= nil and hasDirty then
			for entry in dirty do
				rn, un = pushEntry(reliableBuf, rn, unreliableBuf, un, entry, valueFor(entry, player))
			end
		end
		for i = 1, sn do
			local entry = scopedBuf[i]
			local own = entry._own
			if (own == nil or own[player] == nil) and not (dirty ~= nil and dirty[entry]) then
				rn, un = pushEntry(reliableBuf, rn, unreliableBuf, un, entry, nodeValue(entry))
			end
		end
		if dirty ~= nil and hasDirty then
			table.clear(dirty)
		end
		if rn > 1 or ackDirty[player] then
			ackDirty[player] = nil
			reliable:FireClient(player, table.unpack(reliableBuf, 1, rn))
		end
		if un > 0 then
			unreliable:FireClient(player, table.unpack(unreliableBuf, 1, un))
		end
	end

	if next(globalDirty) ~= nil then
		if next(received) ~= nil then
			rn, un = 0, 0
			for entry in globalDirty do
				if entry._ownCount == 0 then
					rn, un = pushEntry(reliableBuf, rn, unreliableBuf, un, entry, nodeValue(entry))
				end
			end
			if rn > 0 then
				reliable:FireAllClients(table.unpack(reliableBuf, 1, rn))
			end
			if un > 0 then
				unreliable:FireAllClients(table.unpack(unreliableBuf, 1, un))
			end
		end
		table.clear(globalDirty)
	end

	-- release the values the buffers still reference
	table.clear(reliableBuf)
	table.clear(unreliableBuf)
	table.clear(scopedBuf)
end

local function flushClient(sync: Sync)
	local outDirty = sync.outDirty
	if not sync.joined or next(outDirty) == nil then
		return
	end
	local stamp = sync.sent + 1
	local n = 0
	for entry in outDirty do
		local id = entry._id
		if id then
			n = push(reliableBuf, n, id, nodeValue(entry))
			entry._lastSent = stamp
			outDirty[entry] = nil
		end
	end
	if n > 0 then
		sync.sent = stamp
		sync.reliable:FireServer(table.unpack(reliableBuf, 1, n))
		table.clear(reliableBuf)
	end
end

local function flush(sync: Sync)
	if sync.isServer then
		flushServer(sync)
	else
		flushClient(sync)
	end
end

local function playerRemoving(sync: Sync, player: any)
	sync.gone[player] = true
	for _, entry in sync.signals do
		drop(entry, player)
	end
	sync.received[player] = nil
	sync.ackDirty[player] = nil
	sync.playerDirty[player] = nil
end

local function start(sync: Sync)
	if not sync.isServer then
		sync.reliable:FireServer()
	end
end

local function destroy(sync: Sync)
	instances[sync] = nil
	for _, conn in sync.connections do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(sync.connections)
	if default == sync then
		default = nil
	end
	rawDestroy(sync.ready)
end

-- Method form for tests (`inst:flush()`); the module calls the functions directly.
local InstanceMT = table.freeze({
	__index = table.freeze({
		signal = signal,
		flush = flush,
		receive = receive,
		start = start,
		destroy = destroy,
		playerRemoving = playerRemoving,
	}),
})

local function newSync(isServer: boolean, reliable: any, unreliable: any): Sync
	local raw: any = setmetatable({
		isServer = isServer,
		reliable = reliable,
		unreliable = unreliable,
		signals = {},
		byId = {},
		ready = Graph.signal(isServer),
		connections = {},
		count = 0,
		received = {},
		gone = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		ackDirty = {},
		playerDirty = {},
		globalDirty = {},
		announce = {},
		validating = nil,
		wrote = false,
		joined = false,
		sent = 0,
		acked = 0,
		outDirty = {},
	}, InstanceMT)
	local sync: Sync = raw
	instances[sync] = true
	return sync
end

local function onEvent(...: any)
	receive(default :: Sync, ...)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	-- deferred so other PlayerRemoving handlers (saving data, say) can still read `sig:of(player)`
	task.defer(playerRemoving, default :: Sync, player)
end

local function connectClient(sync: Sync, container: Instance)
	local event = container:WaitForChild("SyncEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	local unreliableEvent = container:WaitForChild("SyncUnreliable") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
	sync.reliable = event
	table.insert(sync.connections, event.OnClientEvent:Connect(onEvent))
	table.insert(sync.connections, unreliableEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(onEvent))
	start(sync)
end

local function findOrCreate(container: Instance, name: string, class: "RemoteEvent" | "UnreliableRemoteEvent"): any
	local remote = container:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not remote then
		remote = Instance.new(class)
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = container
	end
	return remote
end

-- Wires the default instance to remotes under this module: the server creates them, a client waits for them in the
-- background so creating signals never yields. Clients only send on the reliable remote, so the server only listens
-- there.
local function getDefault(): Sync
	if default then
		return default
	end
	local runService, players = RunService, Players
	if not Compat.isRoblox or not runService or not players then
		error("Flux.Sync needs Roblox; headless tests use Sync._internal.create", 3)
	end
	if runService:IsServer() then
		local event: RemoteEvent = findOrCreate(script, "SyncEvent", "RemoteEvent")
		local unreliableEvent: UnreliableRemoteEvent = findOrCreate(script, "SyncUnreliable", "UnreliableRemoteEvent")
		local sync = newSync(true, event, unreliableEvent)
		default = sync
		table.insert(sync.connections, event.OnServerEvent:Connect(onEvent))
		table.insert(sync.connections, players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving))
		return sync
	end
	local sync = newSync(false, nil, nil)
	default = sync
	task.spawn(connectClient, sync, script)
	return sync
end

-- `Flux.Sync` and test namespaces share this metatable; a test namespace holds its instance at `_sync`.
local NamespaceMT = {}

function NamespaceMT.__index(ns: any, key: any): any
	local sync = rawget(ns, "_sync") or getDefault()
	if key == "ready" then
		return sync.ready
	end
	return signal(sync, key, nil)
end

function NamespaceMT.__call(ns: any, key: string, initial: any, validate: Validator<any>?): any
	return signal(rawget(ns, "_sync") or getDefault(), key, initial, validate)
end

table.freeze(NamespaceMT)

local function flushDefault()
	if default then
		flush(default)
	end
end

local function stepAll()
	for sync in instances do
		flush(sync)
	end
end

-- Tests: a namespace over remote-shaped tables (`FireClient`/`FireAllClients` or `FireServer`), plus its instance.
local function createInternal(isServer: boolean, reliable: any, unreliable: any?): (Namespace, any)
	local sync = newSync(isServer, reliable, unreliable)
	local function flushThis()
		flush(sync)
	end
	local ns: any = setmetatable({ _sync = sync, flush = flushThis }, NamespaceMT)
	return ns, sync
end

local Sync: any = setmetatable({ flush = flushDefault }, NamespaceMT)

--- @ignore
Sync._internal = table.freeze({
	-- Flushes every Sync instance; init.luau runs it each frame after the graph flush.
	flushAll = stepAll,
	step = stepAll,
	create = createInternal,
})

return Sync :: Namespace & { _internal: any }

-- The property table `Flux.new(className)` accepts (typed properties and events, directives, numeric children), with a

local construct = Edit.new
local editInstance = Edit.edit

local Constructors = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(self: any, class: string)
		if type(class) ~= "string" then
			error(`String expected, got {typeof(class)}`, 3)
		end
		self[class] = function(properties: Type.Map<any>): Instance
			return construct(class, properties)
		end
		return self[class]
	end,
})

local Flux = {
	--[[
	Shared time source for timers, frame callbacks, and deterministic test stepping.
	Call `Clock.manual(true)` and `Clock.step(seconds)` in tests to advance timers, motion, and frame flushes in order.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/tips/testing)
	]]
	Clock = table.freeze({
		now = Clock.now,
		wall = Clock.wall,
		delay = Clock.delay,
		wait = Clock.wait,
		defer = Clock.defer,
		cancel = Clock.cancel,
		connect = Clock.connect,
		manual = Clock.manual,
		isManual = Clock.isManual,
		step = Clock.step,
		drain = Clock.drain,
		reset = Clock.reset,
	}),
	--[[
	Perceptual [`Color3`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/Color3) utilities in Oklab (`lighten`, `saturate`, `mix`, `rotateHue`, and WCAG `contrast`/`readable`).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/color)
	]]
	Color = Motion.Color,
	--[[
	Mutable table of per-class default properties applied by [`Flux.new`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#the-flux-new-function).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/defaults)
	]]
	Defaults = Edit.Defaults,
	--[[
	Instance selectors (`Child`, `Descendant`, `Ancestor`, `Path`, `Query`) for hydrating trees inside [`Flux.edit`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#instance-selectors-flux-find)
	]]
	Find = Edit.Find,
	--[[
	Global behavior flags (`Flags.defaults` toggles per-class defaults in [`Flux.new`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#the-flux-new-function)).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/defaults#disabling-defaults)
	]]
	Flags = Edit.Flags,
	--[[
	Read-only interaction state nodes (`hover`, `press`, `selected`, `focused`) and pointer hit-testing helpers (`pointIn`, `sunk`, `covered`).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact)
	]]
	Interact = table.freeze({
		pointIn = Interact.pointIn,
		sunk = Interact.sunk,
		covered = Interact.covered,
		hover = Interact.hover,
		press = Interact.press,
		selected = Interact.selected,
		focused = Interact.focused,

	--[[
	Advances active [`Flux.spring`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/spring) and [`Flux.tween`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/motion/tween) nodes.
	Stepped automatically each frame, or manually in tests via `Motion.step(dt)`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/tips/testing#full-engine-tests-in-ci)
	]]
	Motion = table.freeze({
		step = Motion.step,

	--[[
	Reactive nodes for viewport size, UI scale, breakpoints, device platform, active input mode, and accessibility settings.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/responsive)
	]]
	Responsive = table.freeze({
		config = Responsive.config,
		platform = Responsive.platform,
		viewport = Responsive.viewport,
		scale = Responsive.scale,
		breakpoint = Responsive.breakpoint,

	--[[

local FluxMT = table.freeze({
	--[[
	Terse untyped constructor for a [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) (`Flux(value)`), [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) (`Flux(fn)`), or [instance property node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#binding-from-an-instance-property) (`Flux(instance, key)`).
	Use `Flux.signal`, `Flux.computed`, and `Flux.property` when you want strict type inference.

	```luau
	local size = Flux(frame, "AbsoluteSize")
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#creating-a-signal)
	]]
	__call = function(_: any, obj: any, propertyName: string?): Graph.Node<any>
		local node = Bind.node(obj, propertyName)
		return node
	end,
})

--[[
Applies reactive properties, events, children, and directives to an existing [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance).
Bindings created inside a [`Flux.scope`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) disconnect when the scope is destroyed.

```luau
Flux.edit(existingLabel) { Text = function() return `HP {health()}` end }
```

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#the-flux-edit-function)
]]
function Flux.edit<T>(instance: T & Instance)
	return function(properties: Type.EditProperties<T>): T
		return editInstance(instance, properties)
	end
end

--[[
Creates a Roblox [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) of `className` with its per-class [defaults](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/defaults) and applies a table of properties, events, children, and directives.
When called inside a [`Flux.scope`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes), the instance is destroyed with the scope.

```luau
Flux.new "Frame" {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = function() return if hovered() then 0 else 0.5 end,
	_attr_Kind = "Panel",
	_tag_Interactive = true,
	Flux.new "UICorner" {},
}
```

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#the-flux-new-function)
]]
function Flux.new<T>(className: T | keyof<Type.Creatable>)
	return Constructors[className] :: (Type.Properties<Type.Resolve<T>>) -> Type.Resolve<T>
end

local syncStep = Sync._internal.flushAll
local function stepFrame(dt: number)
	Motion.step(dt)
	Graph.flush()
	syncStep()
end

if game then
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local frame = if RunService:IsClient() then RunService.PreRender else RunService.Heartbeat
	local _frameConnection = frame:Connect(function(dt: number)
		if not Clock.isManual() then
			stepFrame(dt)
		end
	end)
end

Clock._internal.setFrame(stepFrame)

return table.freeze(setmetatable(Flux, FluxMT))
